basics.title: 零基礎文法
basics.intro: 點上方的分類可以跳到那一組。每章都會記下最佳成績。

chapters.title: be 動詞
intro: be 是英文最常用的動詞之一。中文常把「是」省掉，英文不能省。這一章只談 be：現在式 am / is / are，過去式 was / were。
例句裡的縮寫：n. 名詞、v. 動詞、adj. 形容詞、adv. 副詞、aux. 助動詞。粗體是這一點要看的字。

points.title: 哪個主詞用 am / is / are
body: be 要跟著主詞變。現在式只有三種：am、is、are。
I 用 am。you 用 are，不管是「你」一個人還是「你們」。he、she、it 和單數名詞用 is。we、they 和複數名詞用 are。

examples.en: I am a new employee.
You are on time.
He is in his office.
Today is a holiday.
They are busy.

points.title: 過去式 was / were
body: 說過去的事，be 只剩 was 和 were。I、he、she、it 和單數名詞用 was。you、we、they 和複數名詞用 were。

examples.en: I was at the office yesterday.
You were late this morning.
She was a receptionist last year.
We were in a meeting at noon.
The stores were closed.

points.title: 肯定句
body: 肯定句的順序是「主詞 + be + 後面的字」。中文可以說「餐廳開著」，英文不能省 be，要說 The cafeteria is open.

examples.en: The cafeteria is open.
Mr. Chen is our client.
The files are in the cabinet.
I am available after 3 p.m.
The conference was a success.

points.title: 否定句：isn't、aren't、am not
body: 否定是在 be 後面加 not。縮寫：is not → isn't，are not → aren't，was not → wasn't，were not → weren't。
am not 沒有 amn't 這種寫法。寫成 am not，或把整句縮成 I'm not。

examples.en: I am not hungry.
She isn't in her office.
These numbers aren't correct.
The meeting wasn't long.
We weren't late.

points.title: 縮寫
body: 口語和電子郵件常用縮寫。I'm = I am，you're = you are，he's = he is，she's = she is，it's = it is，we're = we are，they're = they are。he's 有時是 he has，那是另一個動詞，這一章先只記 he is。
三個長得很像的字：it's 是 it is；its 沒有撇號，是「它的」（The company changed its name. 公司改了它的名字）。they're 是 they are；their 是「他們的」；there 是「那裡」，也用在 there is。

examples.en: I'm ready for the interview.
You're right about the schedule.
examples.zh: 關於這個時程，你是對的。

examples.en: It's a short meeting.
We're on the second floor.
They're new clients.

points.title: Yes/No 問句與簡答
body: Yes/No 問句把 be 放到主詞前面：Are you ready? Is she here? Was the meeting long?
簡答要重複 be，不要用 do。肯定的簡答不縮寫：Yes, I am.（不要寫 Yes, I'm.）Yes, she is.（不要寫 Yes, she's.）否定可以縮：No, I'm not. / No, she isn't. / No, they aren't.

examples.en: Are you free at 2 p.m.? — Yes, I am.
examples.zh: 你下午兩點有空嗎？——有，我有空。

examples.en: Is Mr. Lin in the lab? — No, he isn't.
examples.zh: 林先生在實驗室嗎？——不在。

examples.en: Are the samples ready? — Yes, they are.
examples.zh: 樣品準備好了嗎？——準備好了。

examples.en: Was the flight on time? — No, it wasn't.
examples.zh: 班機有準時嗎？——沒有準時。

examples.en: Were they at the seminar? — Yes, they were.

points.title: be 後面：形容詞、名詞、地點
body: be 後面最常見三種資料。形容詞說狀態，例如 busy、ready。名詞說「是什麼」，例如 a driver、an invoice。地點片語說「在哪裡」，例如 in the office、on the desk、at home。

examples.en: The room is quiet.
Anna is an accountant.
The printer is next to the door.
These chairs are comfortable.
The guests were in the lobby.

points.title: there is / there are（「有」不一定是 have）
body: 中文的「有」不要一律翻成 have。have 是「某人擁有」：I have a car. 我有一輛車。
若是「某個地方存在著什麼」，用 there is（後面單數）或 there are（後面複數）。be 跟後面的名詞一致，不是跟 there 一致。
不要寫 There have a book. there 後面用 be，不用 have。也不要把「桌上有一本書」寫成 The desk has a book.

examples.en: There is a message on your desk.
There are three applicants in the waiting room.
examples.zh: 等候室裡有三位應徵者。

examples.en: There is a problem with the invoice.
There were many visitors at the booth.
examples.zh: 攤位那邊當時有很多訪客。

examples.en: I have two tickets, but there is one ticket on the table.
examples.zh: 我有兩張票，但桌上只有一張票。

points.title: 不要把 be 和一般動詞疊在一起
body: 一般動詞（work、mean、need、like）的現在式，疑問和否定用 do 或 does，不是 be。he、she、it 和單數名詞用 does，其餘用 do。does / do 後面的動詞用原形，不加 -s。
be 後面可以接形容詞、名詞、地點，也可以接 V-ing 表示正在進行（She is working. 她正在工作）。be 後面不要直接接原形動詞。She isn't work、What is this word mean 都是錯的。
interested 和 interesting 都是形容詞，意思不同。-ed 是人的感受，-ing 是事物本身的特質。不要寫 I interesting in。

examples.en: What does this word mean?
My wife doesn't work.
I'm interested in music.
The seminar is interesting.
Does your manager need this report?
examples.zh: 你的主管需要這份報告嗎？

quiz.prompt: The manager _____ in a meeting right now.
quiz.full: The manager is in a meeting right now.
quiz.explain: manager 是單數，right now 是現在，所以用 is。are 給 you 或複數，am 只給 I，be 是原形，這裡不能單獨當動詞。

quiz.prompt: I _____ not satisfied with the first draft.
quiz.full: I am not satisfied with the first draft.
quiz.explain: 主詞是 I，否定用 am not。沒有 amn't。satisfied 是形容詞，前面用 be，不是 do。

quiz.prompt: There _____ two copies of the contract on the table.
quiz.full: There are two copies of the contract on the table.
quiz.explain: 這裡的「有」是存在，用 there are，不用 have / has。two copies 是複數，所以用 are，不用 is。

quiz.prompt: _____ the conference room available yesterday afternoon?
quiz.full: Was the conference room available yesterday afternoon?
quiz.explain: conference room 是單數，yesterday 是過去，把 was 放到句首。available 是形容詞，前面用 be。Did 要用在一般動詞，這裡沒有。

quiz.full: My wife doesn't work on weekends.
quiz.explain: work 是一般動詞。否定要用 doesn't + 原形，不能寫 isn't work。若是「此刻正在工作」才用 isn't working（be + V-ing），那是進行式，不是原形 work。

quiz.full: What does this word mean?
quiz.explain: mean 是一般動詞，主詞 this word 是單數，問句用 does，後面動詞用原形 mean。不能說 What is this word mean?

quiz.prompt: The new policy _____ clear to everyone.
quiz.full: The new policy is clear to everyone.
quiz.explain: clear 是形容詞，前面用 be。policy 是單數，用 is。does 要搭配一般動詞，這句沒有。

quiz.prompt: Are you the contact person for this account? — Yes, _____.
quiz.full: Are you the contact person for this account? — Yes, I am.
quiz.explain: 問句是 Are you，簡答就用 am。肯定簡答不縮寫，所以是 Yes, I am，不是 Yes, I'm。這題不是一般動詞，不用 I do。

quiz.prompt: The visitors _____ in the lobby a few minutes ago.
quiz.full: The visitors were in the lobby a few minutes ago.
quiz.explain: visitors 是複數，a few minutes ago 是過去，用 were。in the lobby 是地點，前面用 be，不用 did。

quiz.prompt: I am _____ in the training program.
quiz.full: I am interested in the training program.
quiz.explain: 人「感到」有興趣用 interested。interesting 用來形容事物「令人」有興趣，例如 The program is interesting. interest 當名詞或動詞，不能直接放在 am 後面。

chapters.title: 詞性
chapters.en: 名詞、動詞、形容詞、副詞放哪裡
chapters.blurb: 詞性決定這個字能放在哪
intro: 一個字進句子之前，先問它是名詞、動詞、形容詞還是副詞。多益第五大題多半是在考這個。
例句標了詞性：n. 名詞、v. 動詞、adj. 形容詞、adv. 副詞。

points.title: 四種詞各放哪裡
body: 名詞可以當主詞或受詞，前面常有 a、the 或所有格。動詞是句子的動作或狀態。
形容詞修飾名詞，或放在 be 後面。副詞修飾動詞，說明怎麼做，很多以 -ly 結尾。

examples.en: The report is ready.
She wrote a long report.
examples.zh: 她寫了一份很長的報告。

examples.en: This is an important meeting.
Please read the email carefully.
Her answer was quick.

points.title: 形容詞還是副詞
body: 修飾名詞，或放在 be、seem、look 後面，用形容詞。修飾動詞，用副詞。
impressive 是形容詞（令人印象深刻的）。impressively 是副詞。careful 是形容詞，carefully 是副詞。

examples.en: The result was impressive.
Sales grew impressively.
Be careful with the samples.
She checked the figures carefully.
It was a careful review.
examples.zh: 那是一次很仔細的審閱。

points.title: 名詞還是動詞
body: 空格前面有 a、the、所有格，多半要名詞。空格是句子裡的動作，用動詞。
success 是名詞，succeed 是動詞。creativity 是名詞，所以 her creativity 是對的，her creative 後面還要接名詞。

examples.en: The campaign was a success.
We hope the plan will succeed.
examples.zh: 我們希望這個計畫會成功。

examples.en: Her creativity impressed the client.
examples.zh: 她的創意讓客戶印象深刻。

examples.en: They need to create a simple logo.
examples.zh: 他們需要設計一個簡單的標誌。

examples.en: The designer is creative.

points.title: hard 和 hardly
body: hard 可以是形容詞，意思是難的；也可以是副詞，意思是努力地、猛烈地。
hardly 是另一個字，意思是幾乎不，不是努力地。不要寫 work hardly 來表示努力。

examples.en: The test was hard.
She works hard every day.
I hardly know the new intern.
examples.zh: 我幾乎不認識這位新來的實習生。

examples.en: He could hardly hear the speaker.
examples.zh: 他幾乎聽不到講者的聲音。

examples.en: They hardly ever meet on Fridays.
examples.zh: 他們星期五幾乎不見面。

quiz.full: The presentation was impressive.
quiz.explain: be 後面用形容詞 impressive。impressively 是副詞，impress 是動詞，impression 是名詞。

quiz.full: The team finished the project successfully.
quiz.explain: 修飾動詞 finished，用副詞 successfully。successful 是形容詞。

quiz.prompt: Please be _____ with the glass samples.
quiz.full: Please be careful with the glass samples.
quiz.explain: be 後面用形容詞 careful。carefully 用來修飾動詞，例如 handle the glass carefully。

quiz.full: She read the contract carefully.
quiz.explain: 修飾動詞 read，用副詞 carefully。

quiz.full: Her creativity surprised the whole team.
quiz.explain: Her 後面要名詞。creativity 是創意。creative 是形容詞，後面還需要名詞，例如 her creative idea。

quiz.prompt: We hope the new shop will _____.
quiz.full: We hope the new shop will succeed.
quiz.explain: will 後面要動詞原形 succeed。success 是名詞。

quiz.prompt: From the back row, I could _____ see the slide.
quiz.full: From the back row, I could hardly see the slide.
quiz.explain: hardly 是幾乎不。could hardly see 是幾乎看不到。hard 當副詞是努力地，不能用來表示幾乎沒看見。

quiz.prompt: She works _____ on every big order.
quiz.full: She works hard on every big order.
quiz.explain: 努力地用 hard。She works hard. 是她很努力。hardly 會變成幾乎不工作。

quiz.full: This is an important report.
quiz.explain: an 和 report（名詞）中間要形容詞 important。importance 是名詞。

quiz.full: The launch was a success.
quiz.explain: a 後面要名詞 success。successful 是形容詞，不能直接放在 a 後面。

chapters.title: 一般動詞與 do/does/did
chapters.en: 疑問句、否定句，後面用原形
intro: 一般動詞（work、need、call）的疑問和否定不用 be，用 do、does 或 did。
he、she、it 和單數名詞，現在式用 does；其餘用 do。過去式不論人稱都用 did。助動詞後面的動詞用原形。

points.title: 現在式：do 和 does
body: 肯定句：I work. She works. 第三人稱單數要加 -s 或 -es。
否定和疑問把 -s 移到 does 上，動詞回到原形：She doesn't work. Does she work?

examples.en: She works in the accounting department.
I do not need another copy.
Does your manager need this file?
examples.zh: 你的主管需要這份檔案嗎？

examples.en: They do not open on Sundays.
He doesn't know the password.

points.title: 過去式：did
body: 過去式的疑問和否定一律用 did，後面的動詞用原形，不要再用過去式。
Did she call? 不是 Did she called? She didn't go. 不是 She didn't went.

examples.en: Did she call you yesterday?
I did not see the email.
They didn't go to the seminar.
What did he say about the delay?
examples.zh: 關於這次延誤，他說了什麼？

examples.en: Did the package arrive on time?

points.title: 助動詞後面用原形
body: do、does、did、don't、doesn't、didn't 後面都接原形。不要寫 doesn't works，也不要寫 did went。
肯定句的過去式才用過去式本身：She called. 疑問才拆開：Did she call?

examples.en: She doesn't work on Mondays.
Does this word mean the same thing?
examples.zh: 這個字是同一個意思嗎？

examples.en: We didn't receive the invoice.
Do they offer a discount?
He did not forget the meeting.

points.title: 不要和 be 疊在一起
body: 一般動詞的否定是 doesn't work，不是 isn't work。疑問是 Does this word mean，不是 Is this word mean。
be 用來接形容詞、名詞、地點。工作、需要、意思這種動作或一般動詞，交給 do、does、did。

examples.en: My wife doesn't work on Fridays.
What does this sign mean?
The store isn't open today.
Are the samples ready?
Did you lock the cabinet?

quiz.full: My wife doesn't work on weekends.
quiz.explain: work 是一般動詞，主詞 my wife 是第三人稱單數，否定用 doesn't，後面 work 用原形。isn't work 是把 be 和一般動詞疊在一起。

quiz.full: Did she call you yesterday?
quiz.explain: yesterday 是過去，疑問用 Did，後面 call 用原形，不是 called。Was 要接形容詞或名詞，這裡是一般動詞 call。

quiz.full: He doesn't know the new password.
quiz.explain: doesn't 後面用原形 know，不要再加 -s。-s 已經在 does 上了。

quiz.prompt: What _____ you do after the meeting yesterday?
quiz.full: What did you do after the meeting yesterday?
quiz.explain: yesterday 要用 did。What did you do 的第二個 do 是原形。

quiz.prompt: She _____ to the Taipei office every Tuesday.
quiz.full: She goes to the Taipei office every Tuesday.
quiz.explain: every Tuesday 是習慣，現在簡單式。She 是第三人稱單數，肯定句用 goes。

quiz.full: Do they offer free delivery?
quiz.explain: they 的現在式疑問用 Do，後面 offer 用原形。Are 不能直接接原形 offer。

quiz.full: We did not receive the attachment.
quiz.explain: did not 後面用原形 receive，不要用 received。

quiz.full: What does this abbreviation mean?
quiz.explain: does 後面用原形 mean。不是 What does this abbreviation means?

quiz.prompt: _____ the client satisfied with the sample?
quiz.full: Was the client satisfied with the sample?
quiz.explain: satisfied 是形容詞，前面用 be。問過去用 Was。Did 要接一般動詞，這句沒有。

quiz.prompt: They _____ open the store last Sunday.
quiz.full: They didn't open the store last Sunday.
quiz.explain: last Sunday 是過去，否定用 didn't，後面 open 用原形。weren't open 會把 open 當形容詞，但這裡要說的是「沒有開店」這個動作。

chapters.title: 句型與主詞動詞一致
chapters.en: 五大句型，複數主詞，there 和 have
intro: 英文句子先找主詞和動詞。動詞的單複數要跟主詞走，不跟主詞後面的片語走。
中文的「有」要分兩種：某人擁有用 have；某個地方存在著什麼用 there is 或 there are。

points.title: 五大句型
body: 每句話都是這五種之一。先找出動詞，再看它後面需要什麼。

examples.en: The meeting started.
She wrote a report.
Mr. Lin is an engineer.
She sent me an email.
The delay made the client angry.

rows: 主詞 + 動詞 + 受詞
主詞 + 動詞 + 補語
主詞 + 動詞 + 間接受詞 + 直接受詞
主詞 + 動詞 + 受詞 + 受詞補語
The delay made the client angry.

points.title: 主詞動詞一致
body: 動詞跟主詞一致，不跟主詞後面 of 片語裡的名詞一致。The list of items 的主詞是 list，用 is。
A number of（一些）接複數動詞。The number of（……的數量）接單數動詞。everyone、each、every 接單數動詞。

examples.en: My hobbies are swimming and cooking.
examples.zh: 我的嗜好是游泳和做菜。

examples.en: The list of prices is on the wall.
A number of clients are waiting.
The number of clients is small.
Everyone is in the lobby.

points.title: there is / are 和 have
body: have 是某人擁有：I have a car. there is / there are 是某個地方存在著什麼。
there 後面用 be，不用 have。be 跟後面的名詞一致：單數 is，複數 are。

examples.en: I have two tickets.
There is a printer in the copy room.
There are two printers on the third floor.
The company has a new office.
There is a problem with the invoice.

quiz.full: My hobbies are photography and hiking.
quiz.explain: 主詞 hobbies 是複數，用 are。不要因為中文說「我的嗜好是」就用 is。

quiz.prompt: The list of items _____ on the desk.
quiz.full: The list of items is on the desk.
quiz.explain: 主詞是 list（單數），of items 只是修飾。動詞用 is，不跟 items 走。

quiz.prompt: A number of visitors _____ in the lobby.
quiz.full: A number of visitors are in the lobby.
quiz.explain: A number of 是一些，後面的 visitors 是真正的複數意思，動詞用 are。

quiz.prompt: The number of visitors _____ small today.
quiz.full: The number of visitors is small today.
quiz.explain: The number of 是「數量」，主詞 number 是單數，用 is。

quiz.prompt: There _____ a message on your desk.
quiz.full: There is a message on your desk.
quiz.explain: 桌上有一則留言是存在，用 there is。message 是單數。不要寫 There have。

quiz.prompt: There _____ three copies in the folder.
quiz.full: There are three copies in the folder.
quiz.explain: three copies 是複數，there are。have 是某人擁有，這裡沒有人當主詞。

quiz.prompt: Everyone _____ required to wear a badge.
quiz.full: Everyone is required to wear a badge.
quiz.explain: everyone 當單數，用 is。

quiz.full: She sent me the updated schedule.
quiz.explain: 這是「給某人某物」：sent me the schedule。主詞 She 做了動作 sent。

quiz.full: Our company has three branch offices.
quiz.explain: 公司擁有三間分公司，用 has。there are 用來表示「某地存在」，主詞不會是 our company。

quiz.full: The noise made the baby upset.
quiz.explain: make + 受詞 + 形容詞：made the baby upset。upset 在這裡是形容詞，前面不要再加 is。

chapters.title: 名詞與冠詞
chapters.en: a / an / the，可數與不可數
intro: a 和 an 用在可數名詞的單數，表示一個。the 用在對方知道是哪一個的時候。
advice、information、equipment、luggage、furniture、news 是不可數，不加 a，也不加複數 -s。

points.title: a 和 an
body: 可數名詞第一次提到一個的時候，用 a 或 an。an 接母音「音」，不是看字母：an hour、an engineer，但 a university（發音像 you）、a uniform。

examples.en: I need a pen.
She is an engineer.
The meeting lasted an hour.
He attends a university in Taichung.
Please print a copy.

points.title: 不可數名詞
body: 不可數名詞沒有複數形，前面也不加 a 或 an。要說數量可以用 some、a piece of、a lot of。
常見的有 advice（建議）、information（資訊）、equipment（設備）、furniture（家具）、luggage（行李）、news（新聞）。news 看起來像複數，動詞仍用 is。

examples.en: Could you give me some advice?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一些建議嗎？

examples.en: We need more information.
The equipment is new.
A piece of luggage is missing.
The news is surprising.

points.title: 職業前面要加冠詞
body: 說某人的職業，用 a 或 an：She is an engineer. 不要寫 She is engineer.
the 用在特定的那一個：the engineer who called us，對方知道是哪一位。

examples.en: Ms. Chen is a designer.
He wants to be an accountant.
The accountant called this morning.
examples.zh: 那位會計今天早上打來了。

examples.en: My brother is a nurse.
We hired an intern.
examples.zh: 我們雇用了一位實習生。

points.title: the 不要用太多
body: the 是「那個」，雙方都知道是哪一個才用。泛指全部、或第一次提到一個東西，常常不用 the。
I like music. 是泛指音樂。The music at the party was loud. 才是那場特定的音樂。三餐、大部分語言、運動，泛指時不加 the：have breakfast、speak English、play tennis。

examples.en: I like music.
The music at the party was loud.
examples.zh: 那場派對的音樂很大聲。

examples.en: We have breakfast at eight.
She speaks English at work.
Please close the door.

quiz.prompt: She is _____ engineer at a construction firm.
quiz.full: She is an engineer at a construction firm.
quiz.explain: engineer 是母音開頭的單數可數名詞，職業前面用 an。不要寫 She is engineer.

quiz.full: Could you give me some advice?
quiz.explain: advice 是不可數，不能說 an advice 或 these advice。用 some advice 或 a piece of advice。

quiz.prompt: The equipment _____ ready for the demo.
quiz.full: The equipment is ready for the demo.
quiz.explain: equipment 是不可數，動詞用 is，不要用 are。

quiz.prompt: He hopes to attend _____ university in Japan.
quiz.full: He hopes to attend a university in Japan.
quiz.explain: university 開頭的音是 /ju/，像 you，用 a，不是 an。

quiz.full: The meeting lasted an hour.
quiz.explain: hour 的 h 不發音，開頭是母音，用 an hour。

quiz.prompt: _____ news about the merger is public.
quiz.full: The news about the merger is public.
quiz.explain: news 不可數，不能用 a 或 these。這裡是特定的那則消息，用 The news。動詞用 is。

quiz.full: She speaks English with clients.
quiz.explain: 泛指語言不加 the。She speaks English. the English 會變成「英國人」。English 這裡是語言，不是可數名詞，不能加 a 或 an。

quiz.prompt: Please close _____ door when you leave.
quiz.full: Please close the door when you leave.
quiz.explain: 雙方都知道是哪一扇門，用 the。

quiz.prompt: I need _____ information about the schedule.
quiz.full: I need some information about the schedule.
quiz.explain: information 不可數，不能說 an information 或 many information。用 some information。

quiz.full: My sister works as a nurse.
quiz.explain: 職業用 a nurse。nurse 子音開頭，用 a。

chapters.title: 代名詞
intro: 代名詞要看它在句子裡的工作：做主詞、做受詞、表示誰的，還是自己對自己。
its 是「它的」，沒有撇號。it's 才是 it is。

points.title: 主格：做主詞
body: 主格放在動詞前面當主詞：I、you、he、she、it、we、they。
兩個人當主詞時，自己放後面：My manager and I will attend. 不要寫 me will，也不要把 myself 當主詞。

examples.en: I will call you tomorrow.
She leads the project.
They are our new clients.
My manager and I will attend.
We need a larger room.
examples.zh: 我們需要一間大一點的房間。

points.title: 受格：做受詞
body: 受格放在動詞或介係詞後面：me、you、him、her、it、us、them。
between you and me，介係詞後面用 me，不是 I。

examples.en: Please call me after lunch.
The client asked her a question.
This seat is for him.
Between you and me, the plan is risky.
examples.zh: 這件事只跟你說，這個計畫有風險。

examples.en: The email surprised them.

points.title: 所有格形容詞和所有格代名詞
body: 所有格形容詞後面要接名詞：my、your、his、her、its、our、their。
所有格代名詞單獨使用，不再接名詞：mine、yours、his、hers、ours、theirs。its 沒有這種單獨的形式。

examples.en: This is my badge.
This badge is mine.
Her office is on the second floor.
The idea was theirs.
The company changed its logo.

points.title: 反身代名詞
body: 主詞和受詞是同一個人時用反身代名詞：myself、yourself、himself、herself、itself、ourselves、yourselves、themselves。
I taught myself. 我自己學會的。主詞不要寫 Myself went. 要寫 I went.

examples.en: I hurt myself at the gym.
examples.zh: 我在健身房弄傷了自己。

examples.en: She taught herself the software.
examples.zh: 那個軟體是她自己學會的。

examples.en: The machine turned itself off.
We prepared the slides ourselves.
examples.zh: 簡報是我們自己準備的。

examples.en: Please help yourselves to coffee.

quiz.prompt: My manager and _____ will join the call.
quiz.full: My manager and I will join the call.
quiz.explain: and 後面仍然是主詞，用 I。me 是受格。myself 不用來當主詞。

quiz.prompt: The message was for my colleague and _____.
quiz.full: The message was for my colleague and me.
quiz.explain: 介係詞 for 後面用受格 me。Between you and me 也是同樣的規則。

quiz.full: This umbrella is mine.
quiz.explain: 後面沒有名詞，用所有格代名詞 mine。my 後面必須接名詞，例如 my umbrella。

quiz.full: The firm updated its website.
quiz.explain: 公司是單數 it，所有格是 its，沒有撇號。it's 是 it is。their 是 they 的所有格。

quiz.full: She blamed herself for the error.
quiz.explain: 主詞 she 和受詞是同一個人，用 herself。her 是另外一個人。

quiz.full: Please send the file to them.
quiz.explain: 介係詞 to 後面用受格 them。

quiz.full: They designed the new logo.
quiz.explain: 句子缺主詞，用主格 They。

quiz.full: The victory was ours.
quiz.explain: 後面沒有名詞，用 ours。our 要接名詞，例如 our victory。

quiz.full: He introduced himself to the visitors.
quiz.explain: 介紹的是自己，用 himself。him 是另一個人。

quiz.prompt: Between you and _____, the budget is tight.
quiz.full: Between you and me, the budget is tight.
quiz.explain: between 是介係詞，後面用 me，不是 I。

chapters.title: 現在簡單式 vs 現在進行式
chapters.en: 習慣、事實，對上此刻正在做的事
intro: 現在簡單式講習慣、事實、時刻表。現在進行式講此刻或這一段時間正在進行的事。
know、want、like、need 這種狀態動詞，一般不用進行式。

points.title: 現在簡單式
body: 習慣、真理、公司規定，用現在簡單式。第三人稱單數要加 -s。
時刻表也用現在簡單式：The train leaves at 7. 頻率副詞 usually、always 放在一般動詞前面、be 後面。

examples.en: She works from nine to six.
The train leaves at 7:15.
Water boils at 100 degrees.
She usually arrives early.
He is always busy on Mondays.

points.title: 現在進行式
body: 此刻或這幾天正在進行，用 am / is / are + V-ing。
now、right now、Listen!、Look! 常常是進行式的信號。

examples.en: She is talking to a client right now.
examples.zh: 她這時正在跟客戶說話。

examples.en: Listen! The phone is ringing.
They are preparing the slides.
I am staying at a hotel this week.
Look, the bus is coming.

points.title: 狀態動詞通常不用進行式
body: 表示知道、喜歡、需要、擁有、看起來，多用現在簡單式：know、like、want、need、own、seem。
think 有兩種。I think it is fair. 是想法，不用進行式。I am thinking about the offer. 是正在考慮，可以用進行式。

examples.en: I know the answer.
She wants a window seat.
This laptop belongs to the company.
examples.zh: 這台筆記型電腦是公司的。

examples.en: I think the price is fair.
I am thinking about the offer.

points.title: 怎麼選
body: 句子有 every day、usually、always，多半是現在簡單式。有 right now、at the moment，多半是現在進行式。
不要寫 She is knowing，也不要在現在簡單式漏掉 -s。

examples.en: He checks his email every morning.
He is checking his email right now.
The shop opens at ten.
The shop is opening later today.
examples.zh: 這家店今天會晚一點開門。

examples.en: Do you need a receipt?

quiz.full: Listen! The phone is ringing.
quiz.explain: Listen! 表示此刻正在發生，用 is ringing。

quiz.full: The train leaves at 8:15 every morning.
quiz.explain: every morning 是習慣或時刻表，用現在簡單式 leaves。

quiz.full: I think this price is fair.
quiz.explain: I think 是看法，狀態動詞用現在簡單式。I am thinking about 才是正在考慮。

quiz.full: She is meeting the client right now.
quiz.explain: right now 用現在進行式 is meeting。

quiz.full: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
quiz.explain: 科學事實用現在簡單式 boils。

quiz.full: He checks his inbox every hour.
quiz.explain: every hour 是習慣，第三人稱用 checks。

quiz.prompt: They _____ the display at the moment.
quiz.full: They are setting up the display at the moment.
quiz.explain: at the moment 是此刻，用 are setting up。

quiz.full: This badge belongs to the visitor.
quiz.explain: belong 是狀態動詞，不用進行式。badge 是單數，用 belongs。

quiz.full: She usually arrives before nine.
quiz.explain: usually 是習慣，用 arrives。頻率副詞放在一般動詞前面。

quiz.full: Look, the bus is coming.
quiz.explain: Look 叫你看現在這一刻，用 is coming。

chapters.title: 過去簡單式與過去進行式
chapters.en: 規則與不規則動詞，when 和 while
intro: 過去簡單式是過去發生並且結束的事。規則動詞加 -ed，不規則動詞要個別記。
過去進行式是 was / were + V-ing，表示過去某個時刻正在做的事。

points.title: 規則動詞的過去式
body: 一般直接加 -ed：work → worked。已經有 e 只加 d：live → lived。
子音加 y，把 y 改成 i：study → studied。單音節、一個母音再加一個子音，要重複：stop → stopped。

examples.en: We worked late yesterday.
She lived in Tainan in 2019.
He studied the contract last night.
The machine stopped at noon.
They planned the event in March.
examples.zh: 他們在三月規劃了這場活動。

points.title: 不規則動詞
body: 很多常用動詞不照 -ed。過去式和過去分詞常常不一樣，疑問和否定仍用 did + 原形。

examples.en: I went to the bank after lunch.
She saw the notice on the board.
examples.zh: 她看到布告欄上的通知。

examples.en: We bought new chairs.
He took the early train.
They had a short meeting.

points.title: 過去進行式
body: 過去某個時刻正在做，用 was / were + V-ing。I、he、she、it 用 was；you、we、they 用 were。

examples.en: I was reading the report at 8 p.m.
examples.zh: 晚上八點我正在看報告。

examples.en: They were waiting in the lobby.
She was talking on the phone.
We were having lunch at noon.
It was raining when I left.
examples.zh: 我離開的時候正在下雨。

points.title: when 和 while
body: while 後面常接過去進行式，表示一段持續的背景。when 後面常接過去簡單式，表示打斷的那一下。
I was cooking when the phone rang. 我正在煮東西，電話響了。

examples.en: I was cooking when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正在煮飯時電話響了。

examples.en: While she was speaking, the alarm sounded.
examples.zh: 她正在說話時警報響了。

examples.en: He was driving when he saw the sign.
examples.zh: 他正在開車時看到那個標誌。

examples.en: They arrived while we were eating.
examples.zh: 我們正在吃東西時他們到了。

examples.en: The lights went out while she was printing.

quiz.full: We worked late yesterday.
quiz.explain: yesterday 是過去，規則動詞 work 的過去式是 worked。

quiz.prompt: She _____ to the bank after lunch.
quiz.full: She went to the bank after lunch.
quiz.explain: go 的過去式是 went，不是 goed。

quiz.full: Did you see the notice yesterday?
quiz.explain: 過去的疑問用 Did + 原形 see。不是 Did you saw，也不是 Were you see。

quiz.full: I was reading the report at 8 p.m.
quiz.explain: 晚上八點那個時刻正在做，用 was reading。I 用 was，不用 were。

quiz.prompt: They _____ in the lobby when I arrived.
quiz.full: They were waiting in the lobby when I arrived.
quiz.explain: they 用 were。when I arrived 是打斷的那一刻，前面是正在等。

quiz.full: He studied the contract last night.
quiz.explain: 子音加 y，過去式把 y 改成 i 再加 ed：studied。

quiz.prompt: The lights _____ out while she was printing.
quiz.full: The lights went out while she was printing.
quiz.explain: 燈滅了是一個完成的過去動作，用 went out。while 後面的 was printing 才是正在進行的背景。

quiz.full: She didn't take the early train.
quiz.explain: didn't 後面用原形 take，不是 took。

quiz.prompt: While I _____ lunch, the client called.
quiz.full: While I was having lunch, the client called.
quiz.explain: while 加上一段正在做的事，用 was having。I 用 was。called 是打斷的過去簡單式。

quiz.full: We bought new chairs last month.
quiz.explain: buy 的過去式是 bought。last month 不能用現在式 buy。

chapters.title: 未來式
intro: will 常用在說話當下才決定的事、承諾和預測。be going to 常用在已經有的計畫，或眼前看得到的跡象。
would 是 will 的客氣說法，也用在和事實相反的假設。完整的假設句在第 19 章。

points.title: will：當下決定、承諾、預測
body: 電話響了，你說 I'll get it. 這是當下才決定的。
I think it will rain. 是預測。I'll send the file. 是承諾。

examples.en: The phone is ringing. I'll get it.
I think the shipment will arrive on Friday.
examples.zh: 我認為這批貨星期五會到。

examples.en: I'll send the file before noon.
examples.zh: 我中午以前會把檔案寄出。

examples.en: We will not raise the price this year.
Will you join the call?

points.title: be going to：計畫和跡象
body: 行程已經在行事曆上，用 be going to 或現在進行式表示已排定的事。
眼前有跡象：Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.

examples.en: We are going to meet the supplier tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天要和供應商見面。

examples.en: She is going to take a day off.
Look at those clouds. It is going to rain.
I am meeting the client at three.
They are going to open a new branch.
examples.zh: 他們打算開一間新分店。

points.title: would：客氣和假設
body: Would you like some tea? 比 Do you want 客氣。
和現在事實相反時，if 後面用過去式，結果用 would：If I had time, I would help.

examples.en: Would you like some tea?
Would you mind waiting a moment?
I would be happy to help.
If I had time, I would help you.
examples.zh: 如果我有時間，我會幫你。

examples.en: If I were free, I would join the tour.
examples.zh: 如果我有空，我會參加參訪。

quiz.prompt: The phone is ringing. I _____ it.
quiz.full: The phone is ringing. I'll get it.
quiz.explain: 電話已經在響，這是說話當下的決定，用 I'll get it。

quiz.prompt: We already booked the room. We _____ the supplier at ten.
quiz.full: We already booked the room. We are going to meet the supplier at ten.
quiz.explain: 已經訂了房間，是事先的計畫，用 are going to meet。

quiz.prompt: Look at those dark clouds. It _____.
quiz.full: Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain.
quiz.explain: 眼前有雲這個跡象，用 is going to rain。

quiz.full: Would you like some tea?
quiz.explain: 這是邀請，用 Would you like。Do you like 是問你平時喜不喜歡。

quiz.prompt: If I had more time, I _____ stay longer.
quiz.full: If I had more time, I would stay longer.
quiz.explain: had 表示和現在事實相反，結果用 would，不用 will。

quiz.prompt: I promise I _____ the draft tonight.
quiz.full: I promise I will finish the draft tonight.
quiz.explain: promise 後面是承諾，用 will finish。

quiz.prompt: She _____ a day off next Friday. She told me yesterday.
quiz.full: She is going to take a day off next Friday. She told me yesterday.
quiz.explain: 昨天就說了，是已經有的計畫，用 is going to take。

quiz.prompt: I _____ the client at three. It is on my calendar.
quiz.full: I am meeting the client at three. It is on my calendar.
quiz.explain: 行事曆上已經排好的約定，可以用現在進行式 am meeting 表示未來。

quiz.prompt: We will not _____ the fee this year.
quiz.full: We will not raise the fee this year.
quiz.explain: will not 後面用原形 raise。

quiz.prompt: If I _____ free, I would join you.
quiz.full: If I were free, I would join you.
quiz.explain: 和現在事實相反，if 後面用 were，不用 am 或 will be。

chapters.title: 現在完成式
chapters.en: have / has + 過去分詞，以及 been
intro: 現在完成式是 have 或 has 加過去分詞。它把過去和現在連起來：經驗、最近完成、以及從過去持續到現在。
它不和 yesterday、last year、ago、in 2019 這種明確的過去時間一起用。那些用過去簡單式。

points.title: have / has + 過去分詞
body: I、you、we、they 用 have。he、she、it 用 has。後面一定是過去分詞：seen、finished、gone，不是 saw 或 sawed。
already、just、ever、never、yet 常和現在完成式一起出現。

examples.en: I have seen that movie.
She has finished the report.
We have just arrived.
Have you ever tried this software?
He has not replied yet.

points.title: since 和 for
body: since 接一個起點：since 2020、since Monday。for 接一段長度：for three years、for two hours。
這兩個詞常和現在完成式一起，表示從過去持續到現在。

examples.en: She has lived here since 2020.
I have worked here for five years.
We have been busy since Monday.
examples.zh: 我們從星期一直忙到現在。

examples.en: He has waited for an hour.
They have known each other since college.

points.title: 不要搭配明確的過去時間
body: 有 last year、yesterday、ago、in 2019，用過去簡單式，不用現在完成式。
I saw that movie last year. 不是 I have seen that movie last year.

examples.en: I saw that movie last year.
She joined the firm in 2019.
We met two days ago.
He left the office yesterday.
I have seen that movie.

points.title: been 和 gone
body: have been to 是去過，人已經回來了。have gone to 是人已經出發，現在不在這裡。
have been in 加上一段時間，表示人還待在那裡。have been 也可以接形容詞：have been busy。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Tainan?
She has gone to the bank.
He has been in Taipei for three days.
I have been busy all week.
They have been working since dawn.
examples.zh: 他們從天亮就一直在工作。

quiz.full: I saw that movie last year.
quiz.explain: last year 是明確的過去時間，用過去簡單式 saw，不能用 have seen。

quiz.full: She has lived here since 2020.
quiz.explain: since 2020 表示從那時持續到現在，用 has lived。She 用 has。

quiz.full: Have you ever been to Tainan?
quiz.explain: 問「去過嗎」、人已經回來，用 been to。gone to 多半表示人還在那裡。

quiz.full: She has finished the report.
quiz.explain: has 後面用過去分詞 finished。

quiz.prompt: He has been _____ Taipei for three days.
quiz.full: He has been in Taipei for three days.
quiz.explain: for three days 是還待在那裡的一段時間，用 has been in Taipei。been to 是去過。

quiz.full: We met two days ago.
quiz.explain: two days ago 用過去簡單式 met，不用 have met。

quiz.prompt: I have worked here _____ five years.
quiz.full: I have worked here for five years.
quiz.explain: five years 是一段長度，用 for。since 要接起點，例如 since 2021。

quiz.prompt: She has _____ to the bank, so she is not at her desk.
quiz.full: She has gone to the bank, so she is not at her desk.
quiz.explain: 人現在不在位子上，已經去了銀行，用 has gone。been 會變成去過而且回來了。

quiz.full: Have you finished the slides yet?
quiz.explain: yet 和已經完成與否，用 Have you finished。Did you finish 要有明確的過去時間才比較自然，這裡是到現在為止。

quiz.full: We have been busy since Monday.
quiz.explain: have been 後面可以接形容詞 busy。since Monday 表示從星期一持續到現在。

chapters.title: 助動詞
intro: 這些助動詞後面一律接原形，不加 to，也不加 -s。
must not 是禁止。don't have to 是不必。兩者不要混。

points.title: can 和 could
body: can 是現在的能力或許可。could 是過去的能力，也用來客氣地請求。

examples.en: She can drive.
I can't open this file.
She could swim at the age of five.
Could you repeat that?
Can I borrow your pen?

points.title: may 和 might
body: may 可以是許可，也可以是可能。might 是比較沒把握的可能。
maybe 是副詞，寫成一個字。may be 是兩個字，be 是動詞。

examples.en: May I use your phone?
It may rain this afternoon.
She might be in a meeting.
Maybe the train is late.
The train may be late.

points.title: must 和 don't have to
body: must 是必須。must not 是不准。don't have to 是沒有必要，可以不做。

examples.en: You must wear a badge.
You must not park here.
We don't have to work tomorrow.
Visitors must sign in.
You must not share the password.
examples.zh: 你不准把密碼告訴別人。

points.title: should 和 would rather
body: should 是建議，不是強制。would rather 後面也接原形，表示寧可。

examples.en: You should see a doctor.
We should leave before six.
I would rather stay here.
She would rather not attend.
He should not ignore the warning.

quiz.prompt: You _____ park here. The sign says No Parking.
quiz.full: You must not park here. The sign says No Parking.
quiz.explain: No Parking 是禁止，用 must not。don't have to 只是不必，不是不准。

quiz.prompt: Tomorrow is a holiday, so we _____ come in.
quiz.full: Tomorrow is a holiday, so we don't have to come in.
quiz.explain: 假日不必進公司，用 don't have to。must not 會變成不准來。

quiz.full: May I use your pen?
quiz.explain: 請求許可用 May I。後面 use 是原形，不要加 to。

quiz.prompt: She _____ swim when she was five.
quiz.full: She could swim when she was five.
quiz.explain: 五歲那個過去的能力，用 could，不是 can。

quiz.prompt: You _____ see a doctor if the pain continues.
quiz.full: You should see a doctor if the pain continues.
quiz.explain: 這是建議，用 should，後面接原形 see。

quiz.prompt: I _____ open this file. The format is wrong.
quiz.full: I can't open this file. The format is wrong.
quiz.explain: 現在沒有能力打開，用 can't，後面是原形 open。

quiz.prompt: It _____ rain this afternoon, so bring a coat.
quiz.full: It may rain this afternoon, so bring a coat.
quiz.explain: 可能下雨用 may rain。maybe 是副詞，不能直接接原形 rain。

quiz.prompt: Visitors _____ sign in at the desk.
quiz.full: Visitors must sign in at the desk.
quiz.explain: 規定必須做，用 must，後面 sign 是原形，不要加 to。

quiz.full: I would rather stay here.
quiz.explain: would rather 後面接原形 stay，不加 to。

quiz.full: Could you repeat the price, please?
quiz.explain: 客氣的請求用 Could you + 原形。

chapters.title: 被動語態
intro: 當我們在意的是動作的對象，或不知道是誰做的，用被動：be + 過去分詞。
時態寫在 be 上：is、was、will be、has been。by 後面才是做的人，常常可以省略。

points.title: be + 過去分詞
body: 被動不是 be + 原形，也不是 be + 過去式。write 的過去分詞是 written，不是 wrote。

examples.en: The report is printed every morning.
examples.zh: 報告每天早上會印出來。

examples.en: The window was broken by the storm.
English is spoken here.
The letters were sent yesterday.
The form must be signed.

points.title: 時態在 be 上面
body: 現在：is / are + p.p. 過去：was / were + p.p. 未來：will be + p.p. 已經：has / have been + p.p.

examples.en: The office is cleaned every night.
examples.zh: 辦公室每天晚上有人打掃。

examples.en: The office was cleaned last night.
The office will be cleaned tomorrow.
The office has been cleaned.
The invoices are checked twice.

points.title: by 可以省略
body: 做的人不知道、不重要，或大家心裡有數，就不必寫 by。需要指出是誰，才加 by。

examples.en: The package was delivered this morning.
The package was delivered by a courier.
Mistakes were made.
The speech was written by Ms. Ho.
examples.zh: 這篇演講稿是何小姐寫的。

examples.en: Coffee is served in the lobby.

points.title: 常見錯誤
body: 不要寫 was did、is do、was wrote。助動詞或 be 後面如果是被動，要用過去分詞。
主動是 Someone delivers the mail. 被動是 The mail is delivered.

examples.en: The mail is delivered at noon.
The mail was delivered at noon.
A new policy was introduced.
examples.zh: 有人提出了一項新政策。

examples.en: The seats have been reserved.
The door must be locked.

quiz.full: The letters are delivered every morning.
quiz.explain: 信是被送的，現在的習慣用 are delivered。be 後面用過去分詞 delivered。

quiz.prompt: The window _____ by the storm yesterday.
quiz.full: The window was broken by the storm yesterday.
quiz.explain: by the storm 表示被暴風雨打破，用 was broken。broken 才是過去分詞，broke 是過去式。

quiz.full: The office will be cleaned tomorrow morning.
quiz.explain: 明天的被動是 will be + 過去分詞 cleaned。

quiz.full: The speech was written by Ms. Ho.
quiz.explain: write 的過去分詞是 written。was wrote 是錯的。

quiz.prompt: Coffee _____ in the lobby all day.
quiz.full: Coffee is served in the lobby all day.
quiz.explain: 咖啡被提供，用 is served。

quiz.full: The seats have been reserved already.
quiz.explain: 已經被訂好，用 have been + 過去分詞 reserved。seats 是複數，用 have。

quiz.full: The form must be signed before noon.
quiz.explain: must 後面如果是被動，用 be + 過去分詞：must be signed。

quiz.full: A new policy was introduced last month.
quiz.explain: last month 是過去，被動用 was introduced。

quiz.full: English is spoken in this office.
quiz.explain: speak 的過去分詞是 spoken。is spoken 是被說。

quiz.prompt: The package _____ by a courier this morning.
quiz.full: The package was delivered by a courier this morning.
quiz.explain: this morning 配合過去被動 was delivered。by a courier 是做這件事的人。

chapters.title: 不定詞與動名詞
intro: to + 原形叫不定詞，用來表示目的，也接在 want、hope、decide、plan、need 後面。
V-ing 叫動名詞，可以當主詞，也接在 enjoy、finish、mind 和介係詞後面。

points.title: to + 原形
body: want、hope、decide、plan、need、promise 後面接 to V。
表示目的時也用 to V：She stayed late to finish the report. 她留下來是為了把報告做完。

examples.en: I want to join the call.
She decided to accept the offer.
We need to leave by six.
He hopes to get the job.
She stayed late to finish the report.

points.title: V-ing
body: enjoy、finish、mind、avoid、suggest 後面接 V-ing，不接 to V。
介係詞後面也接 V-ing：thank you for helping、interested in learning。V-ing 也可以當主詞。

examples.en: She enjoys meeting clients.
He finished writing the memo.
Would you mind waiting?
Thank you for helping us.
Learning the software takes time.

points.title: stop 和 remember 有兩種意思
body: stop V-ing 是停止做那件事。stop to V 是停下來，為了去做另一件事。
remember to V 是記得要做（還沒做）。remember V-ing 是記得做過（已經做了）。

examples.en: He stopped smoking last year.
He stopped to buy a coffee.
Remember to lock the door.
I remember locking the door.
We avoided making a scene.
examples.zh: 我們避免把場面弄得很尷尬。

quiz.full: She enjoys meeting clients.
quiz.explain: enjoy 後面接 V-ing，用 meeting，不接 to meet。

quiz.prompt: He stopped _____ a coffee on the way.
quiz.full: He stopped to buy a coffee on the way.
quiz.explain: 路上停下來是為了買咖啡，用 stop to buy。stop buying 是把「買」這個習慣停掉。

quiz.full: He stopped smoking last year.
quiz.explain: last year 加上戒掉的習慣，用 stopped smoking。

quiz.full: Remember to lock the cabinet.
quiz.explain: 這是提醒還沒做的事，用 remember to lock。remember locking 是記得已經鎖過。

quiz.full: I want to join the morning call.
quiz.explain: want 後面接 to join。

quiz.full: Thank you for helping us.
quiz.explain: 介係詞 for 後面接 V-ing：helping。

quiz.full: She stayed late to finish the report.
quiz.explain: 留下來的目的是把報告做完，用 to finish。

quiz.full: Would you mind waiting a moment?
quiz.explain: mind 後面接 waiting。

quiz.full: We decided to accept the offer.
quiz.explain: decide 後面接 to accept。

quiz.full: Learning the software takes time.
quiz.explain: 動名詞 Learning 當主詞。To learning 是錯的。

chapters.title: 介係詞
intro: 時間和地點的 at、on、in 可以一起記：at 最小，on 是一面或一天，in 是一個範圍。
動詞和形容詞後面的固定介係詞，例如 interested in、look forward to，放在常用句型的搭配那一章。

points.title: 時間：at、on、in
body: at 接幾點、noon、night：at 7、at noon、at night。
on 接某一天或日期：on Monday、on May 1、on Monday morning。in 接月、年、季節，以及 morning、afternoon、evening：in May、in 2024、in the morning。

examples.en: The meeting starts at 9.
We close at noon.
The workshop is on Monday.
She was born in May.
I read the paper in the morning.

points.title: 地點：at、on、in
body: at 是一個點：at the desk、at the station。on 是表面或線上：on the desk、on the wall，也用在 on the bus、on the train。
in 是在一個空間裡面：in the room、in Taipei、in the car。

examples.en: She is at her desk.
The keys are on the desk.
They are in the meeting room.
He is on the train.
The branch is in Taichung.

points.title: arrive、in 和 at
body: arrive in 接城市或國家。arrive at 接建築物或較小的地點，例如機場、車站、辦公室。
不要寫 arrive to。

examples.en: We arrived in Taipei at noon.
She arrived at the airport early.
The guests arrived at the office.
He arrived in Japan on Sunday.
They will arrive at the hotel tonight.

points.title: from、to、by、until
body: from 起點，to 終點。by 是最晚不超過那個時間。until 是一直持續到那個時間。

examples.en: The shop is open from nine to six.
examples.zh: 這家店從九點開到六點。

examples.en: Please reply by Friday.
We waited until six.
The sale runs from May to July.
Send the file by noon.

quiz.full: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
quiz.explain: 幾點鐘用 at。on 接某一天，in 接月份或上午這種較大的時段。

quiz.full: The workshop is on Monday morning.
quiz.explain: 某一天，或某一天的早上，用 on Monday morning。

quiz.full: She was born in 1998.
quiz.explain: 年份用 in。

quiz.full: The keys are on the desk.
quiz.explain: 在桌面上用 on the desk。at the desk 是人在位子前工作。

quiz.full: We arrived in Taipei before noon.
quiz.explain: 城市用 arrive in。arrive at 接機場、車站、辦公室這種地點。不要用 arrive to。

quiz.full: She arrived at the airport early.
quiz.explain: 機場是一個地點，用 arrive at the airport。

quiz.full: Please reply by Friday.
quiz.explain: 最晚星期五要回，用 by Friday。until 是一直做到那個時間。

quiz.prompt: I usually read email _____ the morning.
quiz.full: I usually read email in the morning.
quiz.explain: in the morning、in the afternoon、in the evening。例外是 at night。

quiz.prompt: He is _____ the train to Taichung.
quiz.full: He is on the train to Taichung.
quiz.explain: 在火車、公車上用 on the train。小汽車裡用 in the car。

quiz.full: The branch office is in Taichung.
quiz.explain: 城市裡面用 in Taichung。

chapters.title: 連接詞
intro: 連接詞把兩個想法接起來。and 是而且，but 是但是，so 是所以，because 是因為。
although 後面接完整句子。despite 和 in spite of 後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接完整句子。

points.title: and、but、so
body: and 加一個同方向的資訊。but 轉折。so 是結果，原因在前面。

examples.en: She called and left a message.
examples.zh: 她打了電話，而且留了言。

examples.en: The hotel is cheap but clean.
examples.zh: 這家旅館便宜，但是乾淨。

examples.en: I was tired, so I left early.
The file was large, but it uploaded.
examples.zh: 檔案很大，但還是上傳了。

examples.en: We missed the bus and walked.
examples.zh: 我們沒搭上公車，然後走路。

points.title: because 和 because of
body: because 後面接完整句子，要有主詞和動詞。because of 後面接名詞或 V-ing。

examples.en: She left because she was tired.
The flight was delayed because of the fog.
I stayed because the client was late.
examples.zh: 我留下來是因為客戶遲到。

examples.en: We canceled because of the storm.
examples.zh: 我們因為暴風雨取消了。

examples.en: He was promoted because he worked hard.
examples.zh: 他升職是因為他工作很努力。

points.title: although 和 despite
body: although 和 even though 後面是句子：Although it was raining, we went out.
despite 和 in spite of 後面是名詞或 V-ing：Despite the rain, we went out. 不要寫 Despite it was raining.

examples.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
examples.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

examples.en: Despite the rain, we went out.
examples.zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是出門了。

examples.en: Although she was tired, she finished.
Despite being tired, she finished.
Even though the price rose, we ordered.
examples.zh: 即使價格上漲，我們還是下單了。

quiz.prompt: I was tired, _____ I left early.
quiz.full: I was tired, so I left early.
quiz.explain: 前面是原因，後面是結果，用 so。because 要把原因放在它後面。

quiz.full: She left because she was tired.
quiz.explain: 後面是完整的原因 she was tired，用 because。

quiz.prompt: The flight was late _____ the fog.
quiz.full: The flight was late because of the fog.
quiz.explain: the fog 是名詞，不是句子，用 because of。because 後面要有主詞和動詞。

quiz.prompt: _____ it was raining, we went out.
quiz.full: Although it was raining, we went out.
quiz.explain: it was raining 是完整句子，用 Although。Despite 後面不能直接接句子。

quiz.full: Despite the rain, the match continued.
quiz.explain: the rain 是名詞，用 Despite。Although 後面要接句子，例如 Although it rained。

quiz.prompt: _____ being tired, she finished the job.
quiz.full: Despite being tired, she finished the job.
quiz.explain: being tired 是 V-ing，用 Despite。Although 要接 she was tired 這種句子。

quiz.full: The room is small but bright.
quiz.explain: 小和明亮是轉折，用 but。

quiz.prompt: He was promoted _____ he met every target.
quiz.full: He was promoted because he met every target.
quiz.explain: 後面說明升職的原因，而且是完整句子，用 because。

quiz.prompt: We canceled the picnic _____ the storm.
quiz.full: We canceled the picnic because of the storm.
quiz.explain: the storm 是名詞，用 because of。

quiz.full: Even though the price rose, orders increased.
quiz.explain: the price rose 是句子，用 Even though 或 Although。Despite 不能接這個句子。

chapters.title: 比較級與最高級
intro: 短的形容詞加 -er、-est。長的形容詞用 more、most。最高級前面通常有 the。
good、bad 的比較級不是 gooder。比較級用 than，不要寫 more better。

points.title: 短形容詞
body: 一個音節，以及很多兩個音節、字尾是 y 的字，用 -er、-est。y 改成 i：happy → happier → the happiest。
一個母音加一個子音，要重複：big → bigger → the biggest。

examples.en: This bag is heavier than that one.
She is taller than her brother.
Today is the hottest day this month.
examples.zh: 今天是這個月最熱的一天。

examples.en: This copy is clearer than the first one.
He is the busiest person on the team.

points.title: 長形容詞
body: 三個音節，以及多數兩個音節的字，用 more、the most。不要再加 -er。
careful → more careful → the most careful。expensive 也是。

examples.en: This printer is more expensive than ours.
examples.zh: 這台印表機比我們的貴。

examples.en: She is the most careful editor on the team.
examples.zh: 她是團隊裡最仔細的編輯。

examples.en: The second plan is more practical.
This is the most useful feature.
A train is more comfortable than a bus.

points.title: 不規則比較
body: good → better → the best。bad → worse → the worst。far 可以是 farther 或 further。
不要寫 more better、more worse、goodest。

examples.en: This result is better than the last one.
This is the best result this year.
The delay was worse than we expected.
examples.zh: 延誤比我們預期的更糟。

examples.en: Monday was the worst day of the trip.
examples.zh: 星期一是這趟行程最糟的一天。

examples.en: The station is farther than the hotel.

points.title: than 和 the
body: 比較級後面用 than。最高級前面用 the，表示在一整群裡最……。
兩樣東西用比較級。三樣以上用最高級。

examples.en: Tea is cheaper than coffee here.
This is the cheapest room in the hotel.
examples.zh: 這是旅館裡最便宜的房間。

examples.en: Your draft is better than mine.
She gave the best speech of the day.
examples.zh: 她發表了當天最精彩的演講。

examples.en: A bike is slower than a train.

quiz.prompt: This bag is _____ than that one.
quiz.full: This bag is heavier than that one.
quiz.explain: heavy 是短形容詞，y 改 i 加 er：heavier。最高級才是 the heaviest。

quiz.prompt: She is the _____ editor on the team.
quiz.full: She is the most careful editor on the team.
quiz.explain: careful 用 the most careful。比較級 more careful 前面不加 the 來表示「團隊中最」。

quiz.prompt: This is the _____ result we have had.
quiz.full: This is the best result we have had.
quiz.explain: good 的最高級是 best，不是 most good 或 goodest。

quiz.prompt: The delay was _____ than we expected.
quiz.full: The delay was worse than we expected.
quiz.explain: bad 的比較級是 worse。worst 是最高級，這裡有 than，要用比較級。

quiz.full: This printer is more expensive than ours.
quiz.explain: expensive 是長形容詞，比較級用 more expensive。

quiz.prompt: Today is the _____ day this month.
quiz.full: Today is the hottest day this month.
quiz.explain: 在一整個月裡用最高級 the hottest。hot 要重複 t。

quiz.full: Your draft is better than mine.
quiz.explain: 比較級後面用 than。then 是「然後」。

quiz.full: He is taller than his brother.
quiz.explain: tall 加 -er。兩個人相比用比較級，不要用最高級 tallest。

quiz.prompt: It was the _____ day of the trip.
quiz.full: It was the worst day of the trip.
quiz.explain: 一整趟行程裡最糟，用最高級 the worst。

quiz.prompt: A train is more comfortable _____ a bus.
quiz.full: A train is more comfortable than a bus.
quiz.explain: more comfortable 後面用 than。as 用在 as comfortable as。

chapters.title: 關係代名詞
intro: 關係代名詞把後面的句子接到前面的名詞上。who 接人，which 接東西，that 人事物都可以，用在必要的資訊。
關係代名詞如果是後面那個子句的主詞，不要再加一個 he 或 it。

points.title: who 和 which
body: 人用 who。東西、動物、事情用 which。

examples.en: The person who called is our client.
examples.zh: 打電話來的那個人是我們的客戶。

examples.en: The woman who leads the team is Ms. Ho.
examples.zh: 帶領這個團隊的人是何小姐。

examples.en: The email which arrived this morning is urgent.
examples.zh: 今天早上到的那封信很急。

examples.en: The printer which is near the door is broken.
People who arrive late should sign in.

points.title: that
body: that 可以代人或物，用在拿掉就不知道是哪一個的句子裡。
逗號後面的補充說明，不用 that，要用 who 或 which。初學先把 that 用在必要資訊即可。

examples.en: The report that you sent is clear.
examples.zh: 你寄來的那份報告寫得很清楚。

examples.en: The intern that joined yesterday is Ken.
examples.zh: 昨天來的實習生是 Ken。

examples.en: The file that is on the desk is mine.
A client that we trust asked for a discount.
examples.zh: 一個我們信任的客戶要求折扣。

examples.en: The bus that stops here leaves at six.
examples.zh: 停這站的那班公車六點開。

points.title: whose 和 whom
body: whose 表示誰的，後面緊接名詞：the employee whose badge is missing。
介係詞後面指人，用 whom：the client to whom I wrote。口語常把介係詞留在句尾，用 who 或 that。

examples.en: The employee whose badge is missing should see security.
examples.zh: 識別證不見的那位員工應該去找保全。

examples.en: The firm whose logo we designed is in Tainan.
examples.zh: 我們設計標誌的那家公司在台南。

examples.en: The client to whom I sent the file replied.
examples.zh: 我寄檔案的那位客戶回信了。

examples.en: The person to whom you spoke is the manager.
examples.zh: 你剛才通話的對象是經理。

examples.en: I met the designer whose work won the prize.
examples.zh: 我見到了作品得獎的那位設計師。

points.title: 不要多一個主詞
body: The man who is waiting 就可以了。不要寫 The man who he is waiting。who 已經是子詞的主詞。
who 是主格。如果關係代名詞是受詞，書面可以用 whom，但不要再加 him。

examples.en: The man who is waiting is Mr. Chen.
examples.zh: 正在等的那個人是陳先生。

examples.en: The report which you need is ready.
examples.zh: 你需要的那份報告好了。

examples.en: The staff who were late signed the sheet.
examples.zh: 遲到的員工在表上簽了名。

examples.en: The tool that we ordered has arrived.
The woman whom we interviewed accepted the job.
examples.zh: 我們面試的那位女性接受了工作。

quiz.prompt: The person _____ called is our client.
quiz.full: The person who called is our client.
quiz.explain: person 是人，而且 called 缺主詞，用 who。which 用來接東西。

quiz.prompt: The email _____ arrived this morning is urgent.
quiz.full: The email which arrived this morning is urgent.
quiz.explain: email 是東西，arrived 缺主詞，用 which 或 that。who 用來接人。

quiz.prompt: The employee _____ badge is missing should call security.
quiz.full: The employee whose badge is missing should call security.
quiz.explain: 後面緊接名詞 badge，表示誰的識別證，用 whose。

quiz.prompt: The client to _____ I sent the file replied.
quiz.full: The client to whom I sent the file replied.
quiz.explain: 介係詞 to 後面指人，用 whom。

quiz.prompt: The file _____ is on the desk is mine.
quiz.full: The file that is on the desk is mine.
quiz.explain: file 是東西，that 可以接。who 和 whom 用來指人。

quiz.prompt: The man who _____ waiting is Mr. Chen.
quiz.full: The man who is waiting is Mr. Chen.
quiz.explain: who 已經是主詞，不要再加 he。用 who is waiting。

quiz.prompt: People _____ arrive late should sign in.
quiz.full: People who arrive late should sign in.
quiz.explain: people 是人，arrive 缺主詞，用 who。

quiz.prompt: The firm _____ logo we designed is in Tainan.
quiz.full: The firm whose logo we designed is in Tainan.
quiz.explain: logo 是公司的，用 whose logo。

quiz.prompt: The report _____ you sent is clear.
quiz.full: The report that you sent is clear.
quiz.explain: report 是東西，you 已經是 sent 的主詞，關係詞用 that 或 which，不用 who。

quiz.prompt: The woman _____ we interviewed accepted the job.
quiz.full: The woman whom we interviewed accepted the job.
quiz.explain: we interviewed 的受詞是那位女性，書面用 whom。which 用來接東西。

chapters.title: 分詞形容詞
chapters.en: -ed 是感受，-ing 是造成感受的事物
intro: 很多情緒形容詞有兩種字尾。-ed 形容人的感受。-ing 形容造成那種感受的事物。
人感到有興趣是 interested。事物本身有趣是 interesting。介係詞是 interested in。

points.title: -ed：人的感受
body: bored、tired、excited、surprised、interested、disappointed 用來形容人。
I am interested in the course. 不是 I am interesting in the course.

examples.en: I am interested in the course.
She was bored during the talk.
We were tired after the trip.
He is excited about the trip.
They were surprised by the news.
examples.zh: 他們對這個消息感到意外。

points.title: -ing：事物的特質
body: boring、tiring、exciting、surprising、interesting 用來形容事物、活動或人「令人……」。
The talk was boring. 演講令人無聊。She is boring. 也可以說這個人很無趣，那是在形容這個人給人的感覺。

examples.en: The talk was boring.
The trip was tiring.
The news is surprising.
This book is interesting.
The game was exciting.

points.title: 成對比較
body: 先問：是人的感覺，還是東西造成的感覺？人用 -ed，東西用 -ing。

examples.en: I am bored. The movie is boring.
examples.zh: 我覺得很無聊。這部電影很無聊。

examples.en: She is tired. The job is tiring.
examples.zh: 她累了。這份工作很累人。

examples.en: He is excited. The match is exciting.
examples.zh: 他很興奮。這場比賽很刺激。

examples.en: We are surprised. The result is surprising.
examples.zh: 我們很意外。這個結果令人意外。

examples.en: I am interested. The topic is interesting.
examples.zh: 我有興趣。這個題目很有趣。

points.title: 介係詞
body: interested in、excited about、bored with、surprised at 或 by、disappointed with。
不要寫 I interesting in。要有 be，而且用 -ed。

examples.en: I am interested in design.
She is excited about the new role.
He is bored with the routine.
examples.zh: 他對日常工作感到無聊。

examples.en: We were disappointed with the delay.
examples.zh: 我們對這次延誤很失望。

examples.en: I am surprised at the price.
examples.zh: 我對這個價格感到意外。

quiz.prompt: I am _____ in the training program.
quiz.full: I am interested in the training program.
quiz.explain: 人的感受用 interested。interesting 用來形容課程本身。後面的介係詞是 in。

quiz.full: The training program is interesting.
quiz.explain: 課程令人有興趣，用 interesting。

quiz.prompt: She was _____ during the long talk.
quiz.full: She was bored during the long talk.
quiz.explain: 她自己覺得無聊，用 bored。boring 是演講令人無聊。

quiz.full: The long talk was boring.
quiz.explain: 演講本身令人無聊，用 boring。

quiz.full: We were tired after the flight.
quiz.explain: 人累了用 tired。tiring 是令人生累的。

quiz.full: The flight was tiring.
quiz.explain: 飛行過程很累人，用 tiring。

quiz.full: He is excited about the trip.
quiz.explain: 人感到興奮用 excited about。

quiz.full: The result was surprising.
quiz.explain: 結果令人意外，用 surprising。人感到意外才用 surprised。

quiz.full: They were surprised by the news.
quiz.explain: 他們感到意外，用 surprised。

quiz.full: I am interested in digital marketing.
quiz.explain: 固定搭配是 interested in，不是 interested on。

chapters.title: 假設語氣
chapters.en: 與現在或過去事實相反
chapters.blurb: If I were / If I had
intro: 和現在事實相反：if + 過去式，結果用 would + 原形。be 一律用 were。
和過去事實相反：if + had + 過去分詞，結果用 would have + 過去分詞。if 裡面不要再放 would。

points.title: 還有可能的未來
body: 如果還可能發生，if 用現在簡單式，結果用 will。if 裡面不要用 will。
If it rains, we will stay inside. 不是 If it will rain.

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay inside.
examples.zh: 如果下雨，我們就待在室內。

examples.en: If she calls, I will tell her.
examples.zh: 如果她打來，我會告訴她。

examples.en: If the price drops, we will buy more.
examples.zh: 如果價格下降，我們會多買。

examples.en: I will leave if the meeting ends late.
examples.zh: 如果會議很晚結束，我就離開。

examples.en: If you need help, ask me.
examples.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，就問我。

points.title: 和現在事實相反
body: 事實不是這樣。if 用過去式，be 用 were。結果用 would + 原形。
If I were you, I would take the offer. 我不是你，這是假設。

examples.en: If I were you, I would take the offer.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我會接受這個提議。

examples.en: If I had time, I would help.
examples.zh: 如果我有時間，我會幫忙。

examples.en: If she knew the password, she would open it.
examples.zh: 如果她知道密碼，她會打開。

examples.en: If we were free, we would join you.
examples.zh: 如果我們有空，我們會加入你們。

examples.en: I would travel more if I had the money.
examples.zh: 如果我有錢，我會多去旅行。

points.title: 和過去事實相反
body: 事情已經發生，不能重來。if 用 had + 過去分詞，結果用 would have + 過去分詞。
不要寫 If I would have known。would 放在結果，不放在 if。

examples.en: If I had known, I would have called.
examples.zh: 如果我當時知道，我就會打給你。

examples.en: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
examples.zh: 如果她早點離開，就趕上火車了。

examples.en: If we had booked sooner, we would have saved money.
examples.zh: 如果我們早點訂，就省錢了。

examples.en: I would have helped if you had asked.
examples.zh: 如果你當時開口，我會幫忙。

examples.en: If the file had arrived, we would have printed it.
examples.zh: 如果檔案當時到了，我們就印了。

points.title: wish
body: wish 後面談現在的希望，用過去式：I wish I knew. 我希望我知道（其實不知道）。
談過去的後悔，用 had + 過去分詞：I wish I had studied.

examples.en: I wish I knew his number.
examples.zh: 我希望我知道他的號碼。

examples.en: She wishes she were taller.
I wish I had studied harder.
He wishes he had left earlier.
We wish the office were closer.
examples.zh: 我們希望辦公室近一點。

quiz.prompt: If it _____ tomorrow, we will stay inside.
quiz.full: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside.
quiz.explain: 還可能發生的未來，if 用現在簡單式 rains，will 放在結果，不放在 if 裡面。

quiz.prompt: If I _____ you, I would take the offer.
quiz.full: If I were you, I would take the offer.
quiz.explain: 和現在事實相反，be 用 were。結果才用 would。

quiz.prompt: If she had left earlier, she _____ the train.
quiz.full: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
quiz.explain: 和過去事實相反，結果用 would have + 過去分詞 caught。

quiz.full: I wish I knew his number.
quiz.explain: wish 談現在做不到的希望，用過去式 knew，不是 know。

quiz.prompt: If I had known, I _____ you.
quiz.full: If I had known, I would have called you.
quiz.explain: if 已經用 had known，結果用 would have called。不要在 if 裡再放 would。

quiz.prompt: If I _____ more time, I would help.
quiz.full: If I had more time, I would help.
quiz.explain: 和現在事實相反，if 用過去式 had，結果用 would help。

quiz.prompt: I wish I _____ harder at school.
quiz.full: I wish I had studied harder at school.
quiz.explain: 後悔過去，wish 後面用 had studied。

quiz.full: If you need help, ask me.
quiz.explain: 這句是直接的建議，if 用現在式 need，結果用祈使句 ask。

quiz.full: She wishes she were taller.
quiz.explain: wish 後面的 be 用 were，表示現在並非如此。

quiz.prompt: If the file had arrived, we _____ it.
quiz.full: If the file had arrived, we would have printed it.
quiz.explain: 過去沒有發生的假設，結果用 would have printed。

chapters.title: 總複習
chapters.en: 把前面的重點混在一起
intro: 這一章不教新規則，只把最容易混的句子再看一次，然後做混合題。
做的時候先找主詞和動詞，再看時間、詞性和空格前面是什麼字。

points.title: 先看詞性和一致
body: be 後面用形容詞。動詞後面要用副詞時，選 -ly。複數主詞用複數動詞。

examples.en: The result was impressive.
She finished the report carefully.
examples.zh: 她仔細地把報告做完了。

examples.en: My hobbies are cooking and hiking.
examples.zh: 我的嗜好是做菜和健行。

examples.en: She is an engineer.
Could you give me some advice?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一些建議嗎？

points.title: 再看時間
body: yesterday 用過去簡單式。right now 用現在進行式。last year 不能和 have + 過去分詞一起用。

examples.en: She called me yesterday.
She is calling a client right now.
I saw that film last year.
I have seen that film.
If it rains, we will cancel.

points.title: 句子怎麼接
body: although 接句子，despite 接名詞。人的感受用 -ed。關係子句不要多一個主詞。

examples.en: Although it rained, we went out.
examples.zh: 雖然下了雨，我們還是出門了。

examples.en: Despite the rain, we went out.
examples.zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是出門了。

examples.en: I am interested in the course.
The course is interesting.
The person who called is waiting.

quiz.full: The presentation was impressive.
quiz.explain: be 後面用形容詞 impressive。

quiz.full: My hobbies are reading and music.
quiz.explain: hobbies 是複數，用 are。

quiz.full: She is an accountant.
quiz.explain: 職業 accountant 母音開頭，用 an。選項 — 表示不加冠詞，那是錯的。

quiz.full: Please give me some advice.
quiz.explain: advice 不可數，用 some，不能說 an advice。

quiz.full: This seat is mine.
quiz.explain: 後面沒有名詞，用 mine。

quiz.full: Listen! Someone is knocking on the door.
quiz.explain: Listen! 是此刻，用 is knocking。

quiz.full: She went to the bank yesterday.
quiz.explain: yesterday 用過去簡單式 went，不能用 has gone。

quiz.full: Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
quiz.explain: 眼前的跡象用 is going to rain。

quiz.full: I have worked here since 2021.
quiz.explain: since 2021 持續到現在，用 have worked。

quiz.prompt: You _____ park here. It is prohibited.
quiz.full: You must not park here. It is prohibited.
quiz.explain: 禁止用 must not，不是 don't have to。

quiz.full: The letters are delivered every morning.
quiz.explain: 信被送出，現在習慣用 are delivered。

quiz.full: She enjoys meeting new clients.
quiz.explain: enjoy 後面接 meeting。

quiz.full: The workshop is on Friday morning.
quiz.explain: 某一天的早上用 on Friday morning。

quiz.full: Despite the rain, the game continued.
quiz.explain: the rain 是名詞，用 Despite。Although 要接句子。

quiz.prompt: This bag is _____ than that one.
quiz.full: This bag is heavier than that one.
quiz.explain: 短形容詞 heavy 的比較級是 heavier。

quiz.full: I am interested in this course.
quiz.explain: 人的感受用 interested in。

chapters.title: 祈使句與 let's
intro: 祈使句用原形開頭，主詞 you 省略。否定是 Don't + 原形。
Let's + 原形是邀請對方一起做。否定是 Let's not，不是 Let's don't。

points.title: 祈使句
body: 直接用原形：Open the file. Please 可以放前面或後面，語氣比較客氣。

examples.en: Open the file.
Please sit down.
Call me after the meeting.
Be quiet in the lobby.
Turn off the printer.

points.title: 否定祈使句
body: Don't 或 Do not 加原形。be 的否定是 Don't be late. 不是 Be not late.

examples.en: Don't be late.
Do not open that attachment.
Don't forget the badge.
Please don't park here.
Never share your password.
examples.zh: 絕對不要把密碼告訴別人。

points.title: let's
body: Let's 是 Let us 的縮寫，後面用原形。Let's start. 否定是 Let's not wait.

examples.en: Let's start the meeting.
Let's not wait any longer.
Let's take a short break.
Let me check the schedule.
Let's ask the manager.

quiz.full: Open the file, please.
quiz.explain: 祈使句用原形 Open。

quiz.full: Don't be late for the interview.
quiz.explain: 否定祈使句是 Don't be late，不是 Be not late。

quiz.full: Let's start the meeting.
quiz.explain: Let's 後面用原形 start。

quiz.full: Let's not wait any longer.
quiz.explain: Let's 的否定是 Let's not wait，不是 Let's don't wait。

quiz.full: Please sit down.
quiz.explain: Please 後面的祈使句仍用原形 sit。

quiz.prompt: _____ off the lights when you leave.
quiz.full: Turn off the lights when you leave.
quiz.explain: 請對方去做，用原形 Turn。

quiz.full: Do not open that link.
quiz.explain: Do not 後面用原形 open。

quiz.full: Let me check the total.
quiz.explain: Let me 後面用原形 check，不加 to。

quiz.prompt: _____ quiet, please. A call is in progress.
quiz.full: Be quiet, please. A call is in progress.
quiz.explain: 祈使句的 be 用原形 Be quiet。

quiz.full: Let's take a short break.
quiz.explain: Let's 加原形 take。

chapters.title: Wh- 疑問句
chapters.blurb: 疑問詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞
intro: 有疑問詞的問句，順序多半是：疑問詞 + do/does/did/be + 主詞 + 動詞。
如果疑問詞本身就是主詞，不要再加 do：Who called you?

points.title: 語序
body: What did you buy? 不是 What you did buy? 也不是 What did you bought?
where 問地方，when 問時間，why 問原因，how 問方法。

examples.en: What did you buy?
Where is the meeting room?
When does the train leave?
Why was the flight delayed?
How did you hear about the job?
examples.zh: 你怎麼知道這份工作的？

points.title: how much 和 how many
body: how many 接可數複數：how many copies。how much 接不可數，也用來問價錢：how much time、How much is this?

examples.en: How many copies do you need?
How much time do we have?
How much is this printer?
How many people are coming?
How much paper is left?

points.title: who 當主詞
body: Who called you? who 就是主詞，不要寫 Who did call you? 除非要特別強調。
問受詞才需要 did：Who did you call?

examples.en: Who called you yesterday?
Who wrote this report?
Who did you call?
What happened?
Which train leaves at six?

points.title: how long、how often、how far
body: how long 問多久，how often 問多久一次，how far 問多遠。

examples.en: How long is the meeting?
How often do you travel?
How far is the station?
How long have you lived here?
How often does the bus come?

quiz.full: What did you buy yesterday?
quiz.explain: yesterday 用 did，後面 buy 是原形。不是 What did you bought。

quiz.full: Where is the meeting room?
quiz.explain: 房間是單數，用 Where is。這題沒有一般動詞，不用 does。

quiz.full: How many copies do you need?
quiz.explain: copies 是可數複數，用 How many。time、paper、錢用 How much。

quiz.full: How much time do we have?
quiz.explain: time 不可數，用 How much time。

quiz.full: Who wrote this report?
quiz.explain: who 本身是 wrote 的主詞，直接 Who wrote，不要 Who did wrote。

quiz.full: Who did you call last night?
quiz.explain: you 是主詞，who 是受詞，過去用 Who did you call。

quiz.full: When does the train leave?
quiz.explain: 問時間用 When。does 後面 leave 用原形。

quiz.full: How much is this printer?
quiz.explain: 問價錢用 How much is this。

quiz.prompt: How _____ do you travel for work?
quiz.full: How often do you travel for work?
quiz.explain: 問頻率用 How often。

quiz.full: Why was the flight delayed?
quiz.explain: delayed 是過去分詞，和 be 組成被動，過去用 Why was。

chapters.title: 附加問句與簡答
intro: 附加問句貼在句子後面。前面肯定，後面就否定；前面否定，後面就肯定。
簡答要跟事實走，而且肯定簡答不縮寫：Yes, I am. 不是 Yes, I'm.

points.title: 肯定句的附加問句
body: 前面是肯定，tag 用否定，而且代名詞和助動詞要對上。be 用 aren't you，一般動詞用 don't you，過去用 didn't you。

examples.en: You are the new assistant, aren't you?
She works here, doesn't she?
They left early, didn't they?
He can drive, can't he?
The report is ready, isn't it?

points.title: 否定句的附加問句
body: 前面有 not、never、seldom 這類否定意思，tag 用肯定。

examples.en: She isn't here, is she?
You don't need a visa, do you?
He never complains, does he?
They haven't arrived, have they?
We can't park here, can we?

points.title: 幾個特別的
body: I am late, aren't I? 不用 amn't I。Let's begin, shall we? 祈使句常加 will you。

examples.en: I am on the list, aren't I?
Let's begin, shall we?
Open the window, will you?
Don't be late, will you?
I'm early, aren't I?

points.title: 簡答
body: Yes 或 No 要跟事實一致。問句是 Are you ready? 答 Yes, I am. 或 No, I'm not.
不要用 Yes, I do 去回答 be 的問句。肯定的簡答不縮寫。

examples.en: Are you ready? — Yes, I am.
examples.zh: 你準備好了嗎？——準備好了。

examples.en: Does she drive? — No, she doesn't.
Did they call? — Yes, they did.
Is he in? — No, he isn't.
Can you help? — Yes, I can.

quiz.full: You are the new assistant, aren't you?
quiz.explain: 前面是肯定的 are，tag 用否定 aren't you。主詞 you 用 you，不是 isn't you。

quiz.full: She works here, doesn't she?
quiz.explain: works 是一般動詞現在式，tag 用 doesn't she。

quiz.full: They left early, didn't they?
quiz.explain: left 是過去式，tag 用 didn't they。

quiz.full: She isn't here, is she?
quiz.explain: 前面已經否定，tag 用肯定 is she。

quiz.full: I am on the list, aren't I?
quiz.explain: I am 的否定 tag 用 aren't I，沒有 amn't I。

quiz.full: Let's begin, shall we?
quiz.explain: Let's 的附加問句用 shall we。

quiz.full: Are you free? — Yes, I am.
quiz.explain: be 的問句用 I am 回答。肯定簡答不縮寫，不是 Yes, I'm. 也不是 I do。

quiz.full: Does she drive? — No, she doesn't.
quiz.explain: Does 的否定簡答是 she doesn't，不是 she isn't。

quiz.full: He never complains, does he?
quiz.explain: never 讓前面變成否定意思，tag 用肯定 does he。

quiz.full: Open the window, will you?
quiz.explain: 祈使句的附加問句常用 will you。

chapters.title: 禮貌請求
intro: Could you 和 Would you 後面用原形。Would you mind 後面用 V-ing。
mind 的意思是介意。Would you mind opening the window? 是請對方開窗。

points.title: Could you 和 Would you
body: 兩者都比 Can you 客氣。後面是原形。

examples.en: Could you open the window?
Would you hold this for a moment?
Could you send the file again?
examples.zh: 請你再寄一次檔案好嗎？

examples.en: Would you wait here?
Could you speak more slowly?

points.title: Would you mind
body: Would you mind + V-ing。如果是自己想做，用 if I + 過去式：Would you mind if I opened the window?

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?
Would you mind waiting outside?
Would you mind if I opened the window?
Would you mind signing here?
Do you mind helping me?

quiz.full: Could you open the window?
quiz.explain: Could you 後面用原形 open。

quiz.full: Would you mind opening the window?
quiz.explain: mind 後面接 opening。

quiz.prompt: Would you mind if I _____ the window?
quiz.full: Would you mind if I opened the window?
quiz.explain: Would you mind if I 後面用過去式 opened，表示客氣。

quiz.prompt: Would you _____ this for a moment?
quiz.full: Would you hold this for a moment?
quiz.explain: Would you 加原形 hold。

quiz.full: Could you speak more slowly?
quiz.explain: 修飾 speak 用副詞 slowly。

quiz.full: Would you mind waiting outside?
quiz.explain: mind 後面用 waiting。

quiz.prompt: Do you mind _____ me with this box?
quiz.full: Do you mind helping me with this box?
quiz.explain: mind 後面用 helping。

quiz.prompt: Would you mind if I _____ early?
quiz.full: Would you mind if I left early?
quiz.explain: if I 後面用過去式 left。

quiz.full: Could you send the file again?
quiz.explain: Could you send，用原形。

quiz.full: Would you mind signing here?
quiz.explain: mind 後面用 signing。

chapters.title: It takes ... to V
chapters.blurb: It takes ten minutes to walk there.
intro: 說做某件事要花多少時間，用 It takes + 時間 + to V。it 是形式主詞，真正的內容是後面的 to V。
如果要說誰花了時間，把人放在時間前面：It took me an hour to finish.

points.title: 基本句型
body: It takes / took / will take + 時間 + to + 原形。不要寫 It takes ten minutes walking.

examples.en: It takes ten minutes to walk there.
It took an hour to finish the form.
examples.zh: 填完這張表花了一個小時。

examples.en: It will take two days to repair the copier.
It takes practice to type faster.
How long does it take to get to the station?

points.title: 加上是誰
body: It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V。人用受格：me、her、them。

examples.en: It took me an hour to prepare the slides.
examples.zh: 我準備簡報花了一個小時。

examples.en: It takes her twenty minutes to reach the office.
examples.zh: 她到辦公室要二十分鐘。

examples.en: It will take them a week to reply.
examples.zh: 他們要一個星期才會回覆。

examples.en: It took us all morning to move the boxes.
examples.zh: 我們搬那些箱子搬了一整個早上。

examples.en: It didn't take him long to learn the software.
examples.zh: 他沒有花很久就學會那個軟體。

quiz.full: It takes ten minutes to walk there.
quiz.explain: It takes + 時間 + to V，用 to walk，不用 walking。

quiz.prompt: It _____ an hour to finish the form.
quiz.full: It took an hour to finish the form.
quiz.explain: 花時間用 take。這句是過去，用 took。spend 的句型是人當主詞：I spent an hour。

quiz.prompt: It took me an hour _____ the slides.
quiz.full: It took me an hour to prepare the slides.
quiz.explain: to prepare 是真正的動作。me 是花時間的人。

quiz.prompt: How long does it take _____ to the station?
quiz.full: How long does it take to get to the station?
quiz.explain: does it take 後面用 to get。

quiz.prompt: It will _____ two days to repair the copier.
quiz.full: It will take two days to repair the copier.
quiz.explain: will 後面用原形 take。

quiz.prompt: It takes _____ twenty minutes to reach the office.
quiz.full: It takes her twenty minutes to reach the office.
quiz.explain: 花時間的人放在 takes 後面，用受格 her。

quiz.prompt: It didn't take him long _____ the software.
quiz.full: It didn't take him long to learn the software.
quiz.explain: didn't take 後面仍然是 to learn。

quiz.full: It takes practice to type faster.
quiz.explain: practice 是需要的東西，真正的動作是 to type。

quiz.prompt: It _____ us all morning to move the boxes.
quiz.full: It took us all morning to move the boxes.
quiz.explain: 過去花了一整個早上，用 took。cost 是花錢或代價，不是這個句型。

quiz.prompt: It will take them a week _____.
quiz.full: It will take them a week to reply.
quiz.explain: a week 後面用 to reply。

chapters.title: too、enough、so、such
intro: too 是太……而有負面結果。enough 是足夠。so 接形容詞或副詞，such 接名詞片語。
enough 放在形容詞後面、名詞前面：old enough、enough time。

points.title: too ... to
body: too + 形容詞 + to V，表示太……以至於不能。The box is too heavy to lift.

examples.en: The box is too heavy to lift.
examples.zh: 這個箱子太重了，搬不起來。

examples.en: She was too tired to drive.
It is too late to call.
The print is too small to read.
He is too busy to join us.
examples.zh: 他忙到沒辦法加入我們。

points.title: enough
body: 形容詞 + enough + to V：old enough to drive。enough + 名詞：enough time。不要寫 enough old。

examples.en: She is old enough to drive.
examples.zh: 她年紀夠大，可以開車了。

examples.en: We have enough time.
The room is big enough for twenty people.
examples.zh: 這間房間夠大，可以坐二十人。

examples.en: He did not have enough cash.
Is the coffee cool enough to drink?

points.title: so ... that 和 such ... that
body: so + 形容詞 + that + 句子。such + a/an + 形容詞 + 單數名詞 + that。
不要寫 so a long meeting。要寫 such a long meeting，或 so long a meeting（比較少用）。這裡記 such a。

examples.en: The coffee was so hot that I waited.
examples.zh: 咖啡熱到我只好等它涼一點。

examples.en: She spoke so fast that I missed the point.
examples.zh: 她說得太快，我沒聽懂重點。

examples.en: It was such a long meeting that we ordered dinner.
examples.zh: 會議長到我們只好叫晚餐。

examples.en: He made such a loud noise that we complained.
examples.zh: 他製造的噪音大到我們去抱怨。

examples.en: The box was so heavy that we needed help.
examples.zh: 箱子重到我們需要人幫忙。

quiz.prompt: The box is _____ heavy to lift.
quiz.full: The box is too heavy to lift.
quiz.explain: 太重以至於搬不起，用 too heavy to lift。enough 要放在形容詞後面。

quiz.full: She is old enough to drive.
quiz.explain: 形容詞後面用 enough：old enough to drive。不要寫 enough old。

quiz.full: We have enough time to finish.
quiz.explain: 名詞前面用 enough time。

quiz.prompt: The coffee was _____ hot that I waited.
quiz.full: The coffee was so hot that I waited.
quiz.explain: so + 形容詞 + that。such 要接名詞片語。

quiz.prompt: It was _____ a long meeting that we ordered dinner.
quiz.full: It was such a long meeting that we ordered dinner.
quiz.explain: such a + 形容詞 + 單數名詞。不要寫 so a long meeting。

quiz.full: It is too late to call now.
quiz.explain: too late to call。to 後面用原形。

quiz.full: Is the coffee cool enough to drink?
quiz.explain: enough 後面的動作用 to drink。

quiz.full: He did not have enough cash.
quiz.explain: 現金不夠用 enough cash。too cash 不是英文。

quiz.prompt: She spoke _____ fast that I got lost.
quiz.full: She spoke so fast that I got lost.
quiz.explain: fast 是副詞，用 so fast that。

quiz.full: The print is too small to read.
quiz.explain: too small to read，to 加原形。

chapters.title: used to 和 be used to
chapters.en: 過去的習慣，以及習慣於
chapters.blurb: used to V / be used to V-ing
intro: used to + 原形：以前常常，現在不是了。否定是 didn't use to，use 不加 d。
be used to + V-ing：習慣於。這裡的 to 是介係詞。另一個 be used to + 原形是被動，表示「被用來做」。

points.title: used to + 原形
body: 過去的習慣或狀態，現在已經改變。I used to live in Taichung. 我以前住台中。

examples.en: I used to live in Taichung.
She used to work nights.
We used to walk to the office.
examples.zh: 我們以前走路去辦公室。

examples.en: He didn't use to drink coffee.
Did you use to take the bus?

points.title: be used to + V-ing
body: be、get used to 後面是名詞或 V-ing，意思是習慣了。She is used to working late.

examples.en: She is used to working late.
I am used to the noise.
He got used to the new software.
Are you used to driving on the left?
We are getting used to the schedule.
examples.zh: 我們正在習慣這個時間表。

points.title: be used to + 原形
body: 東西被用來做某事，是被動：This knife is used to cut boxes. 這把刀是用來切箱子的。
三個句型的 to 後面不一樣：過去習慣接原形，習慣於接 V-ing，被用來接原形但前面是 be used。

examples.en: This knife is used to cut boxes.
examples.zh: 這把刀是用來切箱子的。

examples.en: The room is used to store samples.
The fund is used to train new staff.
examples.zh: 這筆經費用來訓練新員工。

examples.en: A badge is used to open the door.
The van is used to deliver parts.

quiz.full: I used to live in Taichung.
quiz.explain: 以前住、現在不住，用 used to live。am used to 是習慣於，後面要接 V-ing 或名詞。

quiz.full: He didn't use to drink coffee.
quiz.explain: didn't 後面用原形 use to，不要寫 didn't used to。

quiz.full: She is used to working late.
quiz.explain: be used to 表示習慣於，to 是介係詞，後面用 working。

quiz.full: This knife is used to cut boxes.
quiz.explain: 被用來做某事，用 is used to cut。to cutting 不是這個被動句型。

quiz.prompt: _____ you use to take the bus?
quiz.full: Did you use to take the bus?
quiz.explain: 過去習慣的疑問是 Did you use to，use 不加 d。

quiz.full: I am used to the noise.
quiz.explain: be used to 後面可以接名詞 the noise，表示習慣那些噪音。

quiz.prompt: We _____ walk to the office, but now we drive.
quiz.full: We used to walk to the office, but now we drive.
quiz.explain: 以前走路、現在改開車，用 used to walk。

quiz.prompt: Are you used to _____ on the left?
quiz.full: Are you used to driving on the left?
quiz.explain: 習慣於開車，用 driving。

quiz.full: The room is used to store samples.
quiz.explain: 房間被用來存放，用 is used to store。

quiz.full: She used to work nights.
quiz.explain: used to 後面接原形 work。

chapters.title: 使役動詞
intro: make、let、have 表示叫某人做某事時，受詞後面用原形，不加 to。
have + 物品 + 過去分詞是請別人把東西處理好：I had my computer repaired.

points.title: make、let、have + 原形
body: The manager made him rewrite the report. 不要寫 made him to rewrite.
let 是允許。have 這裡是吩咐。

examples.en: The manager made him rewrite the report.
Let me check the schedule.
I'll have the assistant call you.
She let the intern leave early.
The noise made the baby cry.

points.title: make + 受詞 + 形容詞
body: make 後面也可以接形容詞，表示讓某人變成某種狀態。不要再加 is。

examples.en: The noise made her angry.
The news made us happy.
examples.zh: 這個消息讓我們很高興。

examples.en: Long meetings make me tired.
The joke made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 那個笑話讓大家都笑了。

examples.en: Please make yourself comfortable.

points.title: have something done
body: have + 東西 + 過去分詞，表示請別人做，不是自己做。I had my computer repaired. 我請人把電腦修好了。

examples.en: I had my computer repaired.
She had her hair cut.
We had the office painted.
examples.zh: 我們請人把辦公室油漆了。

examples.en: He will have the car washed.
They had the locks changed.

quiz.prompt: The manager made him _____ the report.
quiz.full: The manager made him rewrite the report.
quiz.explain: make + 受詞 + 原形，不加 to。

quiz.full: Let me check the schedule.
quiz.explain: let + 受詞 + 原形 check。

quiz.full: I'll have the assistant call you.
quiz.explain: have someone do something，用原形 call。called 是 have something done 的分詞，這裡受詞是人。

quiz.full: The noise made her angry.
quiz.explain: make + 受詞 + 形容詞 angry。不要再加 is。

quiz.full: I had my computer repaired.
quiz.explain: 請別人修電腦，用 had my computer repaired。

quiz.full: She let the intern leave early.
quiz.explain: let someone leave，用原形。

quiz.full: We had the office painted.
quiz.explain: 辦公室是被油漆的，用過去分詞 painted。

quiz.full: Long meetings make me tired.
quiz.explain: 人感到累，用形容詞 tired。tiring 是令人生累的。

quiz.full: He will have the car washed.
quiz.explain: have the car washed 是請人洗。will have 後面這個 washed 是過去分詞。

quiz.full: Please make yourself comfortable.
quiz.explain: make yourself comfortable，用形容詞。

chapters.title: want、ask、tell + to V
intro: want、ask、tell、expect、invite、remind 的句型是：動詞 + 人 + to V。
否定是 not to：He told us not to be late. not 放在 to 前面。

points.title: 動詞 + 人 + to V
body: 不要省掉 to。She asked me to send the file. 不是 asked me send.

examples.en: She asked me to send the file.
He told us to wait.
I want you to join the call.
examples.zh: 我希望你加入這通電話。

examples.en: They invited her to speak.
Please remind me to lock the door.

points.title: not to
body: 叫某人不做，用 not to V。not 在 to 前面。

examples.en: He told us not to be late.
She asked me not to share the file.
examples.zh: 她請我不要把檔案傳出去。

examples.en: I warned him not to park there.
examples.zh: 我警告他不要把車停在那裡。

examples.en: They advised her not to sign yet.
examples.zh: 他們建議她先不要簽名。

examples.en: Remind the visitors not to take photos.

points.title: say 和 tell
body: tell 後面要有人：tell me。say 後面不直接接人，要說 say to me，或只說 say that。
這兩個字的轉述用法，下一章的轉述句會再練。

examples.en: She told me the news.
She said that she was busy.
He said to me, "Wait here."
Please tell her to call back.
What did he say?

quiz.full: She asked me to send the file.
quiz.explain: ask + 人 + to V。不要省掉 to。

quiz.full: He told us not to be late.
quiz.explain: 否定是 not to be，not 放在 to 前面。

quiz.full: I want you to join the call.
quiz.explain: want + 人 + to join。

quiz.full: Please remind me to lock the door.
quiz.explain: remind 某人後面用 to lock。

quiz.full: She told me the news.
quiz.explain: 後面直接接人用 told me。said me 是錯的。say 要用 say to me 或 say that。

quiz.full: They invited her to speak.
quiz.explain: invite 某人後面用 to speak。

quiz.full: She asked me not to share the file.
quiz.explain: 請別人不要做，用 not to share。

quiz.full: What did he say?
quiz.explain: 沒有說出對象時用 say。did 後面用原形 say。tell 需要有人。

quiz.full: I warned him not to park there.
quiz.explain: warn 某人不要做，用 not to park。

quiz.full: Please tell her to call back.
quiz.explain: tell her to call back，需要 to。

chapters.title: 感官動詞
chapters.en: see、hear、watch + 受詞 + 原形或 V-ing
chapters.blurb: see her leave / see her leaving
intro: see、hear、watch、feel、notice 後面是「受詞 + 原形」或「受詞 + V-ing」。不要加 to。
原形看整件事。V-ing 強調看到的時候正在進行。兩種都對時，題目會把 to V 放進來當錯誤選項。

points.title: 不要加 to
body: I saw her leave. 不是 I saw her to leave. 也不是 I saw her left.

examples.en: I saw her leave the office.
We heard someone knock.
They watched the technician repair the machine.
examples.zh: 他們看著技術人員修機器。

examples.en: I felt the building shake.
She noticed him wait by the door.

points.title: V-ing 是進行中
body: I saw her leaving. 我看到她當時正在離開。意思和原形接近，但畫面是進行中。

examples.en: I saw her leaving the office.
examples.zh: 我看到她正離開辦公室。

examples.en: We heard someone knocking.
examples.zh: 我們聽到有人正在敲門。

examples.en: They watched the children playing.
I felt the train moving.
She noticed the light flashing.

quiz.full: I saw her leave the office.
quiz.explain: see + 受詞 + 原形 leave，不加 to，也不用 left。leaving 也可以，但這一題的正確選項是 leave。

quiz.full: We heard someone knock.
quiz.explain: hear someone knock，不要加 to。

quiz.full: They watched the children playing.
quiz.explain: 看到正在玩，用 playing。to play 不符合感官動詞的句型。

quiz.full: I felt the building shake.
quiz.explain: felt the building shake，用原形。

quiz.full: She noticed the light flashing.
quiz.explain: 燈正在閃，用 flashing。

quiz.prompt: They watched the technician _____ the machine.
quiz.full: They watched the technician repair the machine.
quiz.explain: watch someone repair，用原形，不加 to。

quiz.prompt: I saw her _____ the building at six.
quiz.full: I saw her leave the building at six.
quiz.explain: saw 已經是過去式，後面的動作用原形 leave，不是 left。

quiz.full: We heard the phone ringing.
quiz.explain: 電話正在響，用 ringing。to ring 是錯的。

quiz.full: I felt the train moving.
quiz.explain: 感覺到正在移動，用 moving。

quiz.prompt: She noticed him _____ by the door.
quiz.full: She noticed him wait by the door.
quiz.explain: notice him wait，用原形。

chapters.title: 間接問句
chapters.blurb: 疑問詞後面改成直述句順序
intro: 把問句放進另一句時，疑問詞後面用直述句順序：主詞 + 動詞。不要再倒裝，也不要再加 do。
Could you tell me where the station is? 不是 where is the station。

points.title: where、when、what 後面
body: 間接問句：疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞。be 放在主詞後面。

examples.en: Could you tell me where the station is?
Do you know when the meeting starts?
examples.zh: 你知道會議什麼時候開始嗎？

examples.en: I wonder what she wants.
Please tell me who called.
Can you explain why the file failed?
examples.zh: 你可以說明檔案為什麼失敗嗎？

points.title: if 和 whether
body: 沒有疑問詞、只問是或不是，用 if 或 whether。
Do you know if the invoice was paid? 後面仍然是直述句順序。

examples.en: Do you know if the invoice was paid?
examples.zh: 你知道發票付了沒有嗎？

examples.en: Could you tell me whether she is in?
I wonder if they received the package.
examples.zh: 我想知道他們收到包裹了沒有。

examples.en: Ask him whether the room is free.
She asked me if I needed help.

quiz.prompt: Could you tell me where the station _____?
quiz.full: Could you tell me where the station is?
quiz.explain: 間接問句用直述句順序：the station is。不要 where is the station。
