quiz.prompt: Do you know when the meeting _____?
quiz.full: Do you know when the meeting starts?
quiz.explain: meeting 是主詞，動詞用 starts。不要再加 does。

quiz.prompt: Could you tell me _____ she is in?
quiz.full: Could you tell me whether she is in?
quiz.explain: 問在不在，用 whether 或 if，後面 she is，不要倒裝。

quiz.full: I wonder what she wants.
quiz.explain: what 後面是 she wants。第三人稱用 wants，不要再加 does。

quiz.prompt: Do you know if the invoice _____ paid?
quiz.full: Do you know if the invoice was paid?
quiz.explain: if 後面用直述句 the invoice was paid。

quiz.full: Please tell me who called.
quiz.explain: who 是 called 的主詞，用 who called。

quiz.prompt: Can you explain why the file _____?
quiz.full: Can you explain why the file failed?
quiz.explain: why 後面是 the file failed，不要倒裝。

quiz.prompt: Ask him _____ the room is free.
quiz.full: Ask him whether the room is free.
quiz.explain: 是非問句放進句子裡，用 whether the room is free。

quiz.prompt: She asked me if I _____ help.
quiz.full: She asked me if I needed help.
quiz.explain: asked 是過去，if 後面用 needed。間接問句不再加 did。

quiz.full: Could you tell me where she works?
quiz.explain: where she works，主詞在動詞前面。

chapters.title: 轉述句
chapters.en: say 和 tell，時態往後移
intro: 轉述別人的話，用 said that 或 told 人 that。tell 一定要有人，say 不要直接接人。
現在的話轉到過去，時態常往後移：am → was，will → would，現在式 → 過去式。

points.title: say 和 tell
body: He said that he was tired. He told me that he was tired. 不要寫 He said me，也不要寫 He told that。

examples.en: He said that he was tired.
He told me that he was tired.
She said she would call.
She told us she would call.
I said that the file was ready.

points.title: 時態往後移
body: 原話 I am busy. 轉述 He said he was busy. 原話 I will go. 轉述 She said she would go.
如果事實到現在仍明顯為真，有時可以不移，但多益常考往後移的那一個。

examples.en: "I am busy." He said he was busy.
"I will go." She said she would go.
"I need help." He said he needed help.
examples.zh: 「我需要幫忙。」他說他需要幫忙。

examples.en: "We are waiting." They said they were waiting.
"I have finished." She said she had finished.

quiz.prompt: He _____ me that he was tired.
quiz.full: He told me that he was tired.
quiz.explain: 有 me 用 told me。said 不直接接人。

quiz.full: He said that he was tired.
quiz.explain: 原話是現在，轉述到過去常用 was。he 是單數，用 was，不用 were。

quiz.full: She said she would call later.
quiz.explain: will 轉述後常變成 would。

quiz.full: He said he needed help.
quiz.explain: need 往後移成 needed。

quiz.full: They said they were waiting.
quiz.explain: are waiting 轉述成 were waiting。they 用 were。

quiz.full: She said she had finished.
quiz.explain: have finished 轉述成 had finished。

quiz.prompt: "I am busy." → He said he _____ busy.
quiz.full: He said he was busy.
quiz.explain: am 轉成 was。

quiz.prompt: She _____ that the file was ready.
quiz.full: She said that the file was ready.
quiz.explain: 沒有說出聽的人，用 said that。told 必須有人。

quiz.prompt: He told us the train _____ late.
quiz.full: He told us the train was late.
quiz.explain: 轉述過去時，is 常變成 was。train 是單數。

quiz.prompt: I said I _____ the draft that night.
quiz.full: I said I would send the draft that night.
quiz.explain: will send 轉述成 would send。

chapters.title: 名詞子句
intro: 名詞子句在句子裡當名詞用，可以放在動詞後面。that 常可省略。
不確定是或不是，用 whether 或 if。句子當主詞或放在 be 後面，用 whether，比較不用 if。

points.title: that
body: I think that the price is fair. that 可以省：I think the price is fair.
that 子句用直述句順序。

examples.en: I think that the price is fair.
She said that she was busy.
We know that the flight is late.
I hope that you can come.
He believes the plan will work.
examples.zh: 他相信這個計畫行得通。

points.title: whether 和 if
body: I don't know whether she will come. if 在動詞後面也可以。
Whether she agrees or not, we need an answer. whether or not 不要換成 if or not。

examples.en: I don't know whether she will come.
I don't know if she will come.
The question is whether we should wait.
Whether she agrees or not, we need an answer.
examples.zh: 不管她同不同意，我們都需要一個答案。

examples.en: Ask whether the room is free.

quiz.prompt: I think _____ the price is fair.
quiz.full: I think that the price is fair.
quiz.explain: 敘述一個想法，用 that。that 也可以省略，但這一題的四個選項裡 that 才是對的。

quiz.prompt: The question is _____ we should sign today.
quiz.full: The question is whether we should sign today.
quiz.explain: 問題是該不該，用 whether。放在 is 後面不用 if。that 後面不該是問句意思。

quiz.prompt: I don't know _____ she will come.
quiz.full: I don't know whether she will come.
quiz.explain: 不知道會不會來，用 whether 或 if。that 用來陳述事實，不是二選一。

quiz.prompt: _____ she agrees or not, we need an answer.
quiz.full: Whether she agrees or not, we need an answer.
quiz.explain: Whether ... or not 可以放在句首。If ... or not 不這樣用。

quiz.prompt: We know _____ the flight is late.
quiz.full: We know that the flight is late.
quiz.explain: 已經知道的事實用 that。

quiz.full: Ask whether the room is free.
quiz.explain: 問是否有空，用 whether。

quiz.full: She said that she was busy.
quiz.explain: said 後面的內容用 that。

quiz.full: I hope that you can come.
quiz.explain: hope 後面是希望的內容，用 that。

quiz.full: He believes the plan will work.
quiz.explain: believes 後面的子句用 will work。does work 是強調，一般不用。

quiz.prompt: I don't know if they _____ the package.
quiz.full: I don't know if they received the package.
quiz.explain: if 後面是直述句 they received，不要再加 did。

chapters.title: 時間子句
chapters.blurb: 時間子句用現在式表未來
intro: 時間子句講的是未來，動詞仍用現在簡單式，will 放在主句。
When she arrives, we will start. 不是 When she will arrive.

points.title: when、after、before、as soon as
body: 這些詞後面如果是未來的時間，用現在式。will 放在另一邊。

examples.en: I will call you when I arrive.
We will start after everyone sits down.
examples.zh: 等大家都坐下我們就開始。

examples.en: Please wait here until the manager comes back.
examples.zh: 請在這裡等到主管回來。

examples.en: As soon as the file is ready, I will send it.
Before she leaves, she will lock the door.

points.title: 時間子句裡不要 will
body: 中文說「當她會到的時候」，英文的 when 裡面不要 will。
主句才用 will、can 或祈使句。

examples.en: Call me when you land.
I will text you after the meeting ends.
examples.zh: 會議結束後我會傳訊息給你。

examples.en: Don't leave until I return.
We can start as soon as he arrives.
examples.zh: 他一到我們就可以開始。

examples.en: When the bell rings, please stand up.

quiz.prompt: I will call you when I _____.
quiz.full: I will call you when I arrive.
quiz.explain: when 裡面講未來，用現在式 arrive。will 已經在主句。

quiz.full: We will start after everyone sits down.
quiz.explain: after 後面用 sits，不用 will sit。

quiz.full: Wait here until the manager comes back.
quiz.explain: until 後面用 comes。

quiz.prompt: As soon as the file _____ ready, I will send it.
quiz.full: As soon as the file is ready, I will send it.
quiz.explain: as soon as 後面用 is ready。will 放在 I will send。

quiz.prompt: Before she _____, she will lock the door.
quiz.full: Before she leaves, she will lock the door.
quiz.explain: Before she leaves，用現在式。

quiz.full: Call me when you land.
quiz.explain: 祈使句 Call me 是主句，when you land 用現在式。

quiz.full: Don't leave until I return.
quiz.explain: until I return，不要 will return。

quiz.prompt: We can start as soon as he _____.
quiz.full: We can start as soon as he arrives.
quiz.explain: as soon as he arrives。can 在主句。

quiz.prompt: When the bell _____, please stand up.
quiz.full: When the bell rings, please stand up.
quiz.explain: bell 是單數，用 rings。

quiz.prompt: I will text you after the meeting _____.
quiz.full: I will text you after the meeting ends.
quiz.explain: after the meeting ends，will 只出現在 I will text。

chapters.title: either、neither、both、not only
chapters.en: 兩者、兩者都不、不但……而且
chapters.blurb: 動詞跟靠近的那個主詞
intro: both A and B 當複數。either of / neither of 後面雖然是複數名詞，動詞常用單數。
either ... or、neither ... nor、not only ... but also，動詞跟比較近的那個主詞。

points.title: both
body: both of the reports are ready. both A and B 用複數動詞。

examples.en: Both reports are ready.
Both of the printers work.
Both the manager and the intern were there.
Both candidates are qualified.
I invited both of them.

points.title: either of 和 neither of
body: either of the plans is fine. neither of the printers works. of 後面是複數名詞，動詞仍常用單數。

examples.en: Either of the plans is fine.
examples.zh: 兩個計畫哪一個都可以。

examples.en: Neither of the printers works.
Either option is acceptable.
Neither answer is correct.
Neither of them was late.

points.title: or、nor、not only
body: 動詞跟靠近的主詞一致。Either the interns or the supervisor is here. 靠近的是 supervisor，用 is。
Not only the director but also the staff members were invited. 靠近的是複數 staff members，用 were。

examples.en: Either the interns or the supervisor is here.
examples.zh: 不是實習生在，就是主管在。

examples.en: Either the supervisor or the interns are here.
examples.zh: 不是主管在，就是實習生們在。

examples.en: Neither the supervisor nor the interns were ready.
examples.zh: 主管和實習生都還沒準備好。

examples.en: Not only the director but also the staff were invited.
examples.zh: 不只主任，員工們也被邀請了。

examples.en: Not only the staff but also the director was invited.
examples.zh: 不只員工，主任也被邀請了。

quiz.full: Both of the reports are ready.
quiz.explain: both of 當複數，用 are。

quiz.full: Neither of the printers works.
quiz.explain: neither of + 複數名詞，動詞常用單數 works。

quiz.full: Either of the plans is fine.
quiz.explain: either of 當單數，用 is。

quiz.prompt: Either the interns or the supervisor _____ in the lab.
quiz.full: Either the interns or the supervisor is in the lab.
quiz.explain: either ... or 的動詞跟靠近的 supervisor，用 is。

quiz.prompt: Either the supervisor or the interns _____ in the lab.
quiz.full: Either the supervisor or the interns are in the lab.
quiz.explain: 靠近的是複數 interns，用 are。

quiz.prompt: Not only the director but also the staff members _____ invited.
quiz.full: Not only the director but also the staff members were invited.
quiz.explain: not only ... but also 跟靠近的 staff members，複數用 were。

quiz.prompt: Not only the staff but also the director _____ invited.
quiz.full: Not only the staff but also the director was invited.
quiz.explain: 靠近的 director 是單數，用 was。

quiz.full: Neither answer is correct.
quiz.explain: neither + 單數名詞 answer，用 is。

quiz.prompt: Both the manager and the intern _____ there.
quiz.full: Both the manager and the intern were there.
quiz.explain: both A and B 用複數 were。

quiz.full: Neither of them was late.
quiz.explain: neither of them 當單數，過去用 was。

chapters.title: 量詞
chapters.blurb: few 幾乎沒有，a few 有一些
intro: many、a few、few 接可數複數。much、a little、little 接不可數。
a few 和 a little 是有一些。few 和 little 沒有 a，語氣是幾乎沒有。some 用在肯定句和邀請。any 用在疑問和否定。

points.title: many 和 much
body: many emails、many people。much time、much money、much information。

examples.en: We received many emails.
There isn't much time.
How many people are coming?
How much money do we need?
She doesn't have much experience.

points.title: a few、few、a little、little
body: a few chairs 有幾張椅子。few chairs 幾乎沒有椅子。a little time 有一點時間。little time 幾乎沒時間。

examples.en: We have a few questions.
Few people knew the password.
There is a little time left.
There is little time left.
examples.zh: 剩下的時間幾乎沒有了。

examples.en: I need a few days.

points.title: some 和 any
body: 肯定句用 some。疑問和否定多用 any。邀請和請求可以用 some：Would you like some coffee?

examples.en: There is some paper in the tray.
Do you have any questions?
We don't have any milk.
Would you like some coffee?
I bought some stamps.

quiz.full: We received many emails this morning.
quiz.explain: emails 是可數複數，用 many。much 接不可數。

quiz.full: There isn't much time.
quiz.explain: time 不可數，否定句用 much。

quiz.full: We have a few questions for you.
quiz.explain: questions 可數，有一些用 a few。a little 接不可數。

quiz.prompt: _____ people knew the code, so it stayed secret.
quiz.full: Few people knew the code, so it stayed secret.
quiz.explain: 後面說因此仍然保密，表示幾乎沒有人知道，用 Few，不是 A few。

quiz.prompt: There is _____ time left, so we can review it.
quiz.full: There is a little time left, so we can review it.
quiz.explain: 還可以再看一次，表示還有一點時間，用 a little time。

quiz.full: Do you have any questions?
quiz.explain: 疑問句用 any questions。

quiz.full: Would you like some coffee?
quiz.explain: 邀請用 some coffee。coffee 不可數，不能用 many 或 a few。

quiz.full: She doesn't have much experience.
quiz.explain: experience 不可數，用 much。

quiz.full: I need a few days to finish.
quiz.explain: days 可數，用 a few days。

quiz.prompt: There is _____ milk in the fridge. Please buy some.
quiz.full: There is little milk in the fridge. Please buy some.
quiz.explain: 請你去買，表示幾乎沒有，用 little milk。a little 是還有一點。few 接可數。

chapters.title: 介係詞搭配
chapters.en: 多益常一起出現的介係詞
intro: 這些搭配要整組記。介係詞後面如果是動詞，用 V-ing。
時間地點的 at、on、in 在第 14 章。這一章是動詞和形容詞後面的介係詞。

points.title: 形容詞 + 介係詞
body: interested in、good at、responsible for、familiar with、married to。

examples.en: I am interested in the course.
She is good at numbers.
He is responsible for the budget.
Are you familiar with this software?
She is married to a doctor.

points.title: 動詞 + 介係詞
body: depend on、belong to、wait for、listen to、apologize for。apologize to 某人 for 某事。

examples.en: The result depends on the weather.
This badge belongs to the company.
We waited for the bus.
Please listen to the announcement.
She apologized for the delay.

points.title: to 有時是介係詞
body: look forward to、be used to 的 to 是介係詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing。
apply for 一份工作。consist of 由……組成。according to 根據。

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
She applied for the job.
The team consists of five people.
examples.zh: 這個團隊由五個人組成。

examples.en: According to the schedule, we start at nine.
examples.zh: 根據時間表，我們九點開始。

examples.en: We look forward to your reply.

points.title: 不要多加介係詞
body: discuss、enter、mention、approach 後面直接接受詞，不要加 about 或 into。
return 也不要再加 back。

examples.en: We discussed the budget.
Please enter the room quietly.
She mentioned the problem.
He returned the key.
They approached the client.

quiz.full: I am interested in the course.
quiz.explain: interested in 是固定搭配。

quiz.full: She is good at numbers.
quiz.explain: good at 是擅長。

quiz.full: He is responsible for the budget.
quiz.explain: responsible for 是負責。

quiz.full: The result depends on the weather.
quiz.explain: depend on，不是 depend of 或 depend in。

quiz.prompt: I look forward to _____ from you.
quiz.full: I look forward to hearing from you.
quiz.explain: look forward to 的 to 是介係詞，後面用 hearing。

quiz.full: She applied for the job.
quiz.explain: 應徵一份工作用 apply for。apply to 是向某個機構提出。

quiz.full: The team consists of five people.
quiz.explain: 組成用 consist of。

quiz.prompt: We discussed _____ budget for an hour.
quiz.full: We discussed the budget for an hour.
quiz.explain: discuss 後面直接接 the budget，不要 discuss about。

quiz.full: Please enter the room quietly.
quiz.explain: enter the room，不必加 into。

quiz.full: This badge belongs to the company.
quiz.explain: 固定搭配是 belong to。

chapters.title: as...as 與 the more
chapters.blurb: as tall as / the more ... the more
intro: as + 形容詞 + as 是一樣。not as ... as 是不如。
the + 比較級 ..., the + 比較級 ... 是愈……愈……。比較級的拼法和第 16 章相同。

points.title: as ... as
body: This printer is as fast as the old one. 否定是 not as fast as，或 not so fast as。

examples.en: This printer is as fast as the old one.
examples.zh: 這台印表機和舊的一樣快。

examples.en: The new plan is not as expensive as the first one.
examples.zh: 新計畫沒有第一個那麼貴。

examples.en: She is as careful as her manager.
examples.zh: 她和她的主管一樣仔細。

examples.en: Today is not as cold as yesterday.
He works as hard as anyone here.
examples.zh: 他和這裡任何人一樣努力。

points.title: the more ... the more
body: 兩個比較級成對。The more you practice, the better you get.
The sooner, the better. 愈快愈好。

examples.en: The more you practice, the better you get.
The sooner we decide, the better.
The harder she worked, the more tired she became.
The larger the order, the lower the price.
The earlier we leave, the less traffic we meet.
examples.zh: 我們愈早走，碰到的車潮愈少。

quiz.prompt: This printer is _____ fast as the old one.
quiz.full: This printer is as fast as the old one.
quiz.explain: 一樣快用 as fast as。句首沒有 not，不用 so。

quiz.prompt: The new plan is not _____ expensive as the first.
quiz.full: The new plan is not as expensive as the first.
quiz.explain: not as expensive as 是沒有那麼貴。

quiz.prompt: The more you practice, the _____ you get.
quiz.full: The more you practice, the better you get.
quiz.explain: 愈練習愈好，用比較級 better，不是最高級 best。

quiz.full: The sooner we decide, the better.
quiz.explain: the + 比較級 sooner。

quiz.prompt: She works as _____ as anyone here.
quiz.full: She works as hard as anyone here.
quiz.explain: 一樣努力是 as hard as。hardly 是幾乎不。

quiz.prompt: Today is not as _____ as yesterday.
quiz.full: Today is not as cold as yesterday.
quiz.explain: as 和 as 中間用原級 cold，不要比較級 colder。

quiz.prompt: The larger the order, the _____ the price.
quiz.full: The larger the order, the lower the price.
quiz.explain: 愈大愈低，兩邊都用比較級。lower 是 low 的比較級。

quiz.prompt: The harder she worked, the _____ tired she became.
quiz.full: The harder she worked, the more tired she became.
quiz.explain: the more tired。tired 前面用 more，不是 most。

quiz.prompt: He is as careful _____ his manager.
quiz.full: He is as careful as his manager.
quiz.explain: as careful as，第二個是 as，不是 than。

quiz.prompt: The earlier we leave, the _____ traffic we meet.
quiz.full: The earlier we leave, the less traffic we meet.
quiz.explain: traffic 不可數，用 less。fewer 接可數名詞。least 是最高級。

chapters.title: 強調與倒裝
chapters.en: Not only、Never，以及 It is ... that
intro: 否定詞放在句首時，助動詞放到主詞前面，像問句一樣。這是多益會出現的倒裝。
It is ... that 用來強調某一部分。It was the delay that caused the complaint.

points.title: Not only
body: Not only did she apologize, but she also sent a new sample.
did 在 she 前面。不要寫 Not only she did apologize。also 常和 but 一起。

examples.en: Not only did she apologize, but she also sent a sample.
examples.zh: 她不但道歉，還寄了樣品。

examples.en: Not only does he design, but he also writes.
Not only was the flight late, but the bags were lost.
examples.zh: 不只班機晚點，行李也不見了。

examples.en: Not only can she type fast, but she also edits well.
examples.zh: 她不但打字快，編輯也很好。

examples.en: Not only did they call, but they also visited.
examples.zh: 他們不但打了電話，還親自來了。

points.title: Never 和 Rarely
body: Never have we seen such a delay. Rarely does he complain.
否定副詞在句首，後面用倒裝。意思和 We have never seen 一樣，只是語氣較強。

examples.en: Never have we seen such a delay.
examples.zh: 我們從來沒有看過這樣的延誤。

examples.en: Rarely does he complain.
Seldom do they miss a deadline.
Never has she been late.
Rarely did the manager raise her voice.

points.title: It is ... that
body: 把要強調的部分放在 It is 和 that 中間。It was the price that surprised us. 強調的是價格。

examples.en: It was the price that surprised us.
It is the delay that caused the complaint.
examples.zh: 引起抱怨的是這次延誤。

examples.en: It was Ms. Ho who wrote the speech.
It is quality that matters.
It was yesterday that they signed.

quiz.prompt: Not only _____ the email, but she also called.
quiz.full: Not only did she send the email, but she also called.
quiz.explain: Not only 在句首，用 did she send，助動詞在主詞前面。

quiz.full: Never have we seen such a long delay.
quiz.explain: Never 在句首，用 have we seen。We have never seen 是平常語序，不能直接接在 Never 後面。

quiz.full: Rarely does he complain.
quiz.explain: Rarely 後面倒裝，he 是第三人稱，用 does he complain。

quiz.prompt: It was the delay _____ caused the complaint.
quiz.full: It was the delay that caused the complaint.
quiz.explain: It was ... that 強調 the delay。事情用 that。

quiz.prompt: It was Ms. Ho _____ wrote the speech.
quiz.full: It was Ms. Ho who wrote the speech.
quiz.explain: 強調的是人，用 who wrote。

quiz.prompt: Not only _____ the flight late, but the bags were lost.
quiz.full: Not only was the flight late, but the bags were lost.
quiz.explain: flight 是單數，Not only was the flight late。

quiz.full: Seldom do they miss a deadline.
quiz.explain: they 用 do they miss。Seldom 在句首要倒裝。

quiz.full: Never has she been late.
quiz.explain: she 用 has she been。Never has she been late。

quiz.full: It is quality that matters.
quiz.explain: quality 是事物，用 that matters。

quiz.prompt: Not only does he design, but he also _____.
quiz.full: Not only does he design, but he also writes.
quiz.explain: but he also 後面是正常語序，he writes。does 已經用在前半句。

suffix.title: 字尾構詞
suffix.blurb: 字尾怎麼改變詞性，再做選詞填空。
intro: 字尾會改變一個字的詞性。多益第五大題常要你選對的形：空格要的是名詞、形容詞，還是副詞。
先看常見字尾，再看同一族的字怎麼排進名詞、動詞、形容詞、副詞。格子若是 —，表示這個家族沒有常用的那個形，不要硬造一個字。

groups.title: 名詞
groups.intro: 下面這些字尾，做出來的字多半是名詞。

body: 很多動詞變成「這件事」或「結果」時用 -tion 或 -sion。拼字常常會改，要整組記，不要只在字尾加字母。
形容詞加 -ness，變成「那種性質」。字尾是子音加 y 時，y 改成 i。
動詞加 -ment，常變成名詞，表示動作或結果。
形容詞加 -ity，常變成名詞。
多半指做這件事的人。-er 比較常見，有些字用 -or。
items.note: employee 是被雇用的人。-ee 指「被……的人」，和 -er 方向相反。

body: 這兩個字尾多半是名詞。和動詞一起記比較快。

groups.title: 形容詞
groups.intro: 這些字尾做出來的字，用來修飾名詞，或放在 be 後面。

body: 名詞加 -ful，表示「充滿……的」。注意是 -ful，不是 -full。
表示「沒有……的」，和 -ful 相反。
表示「有這種性質的」。
表示「可以……的、能夠被……的」。
pairs: avail → available　可取得的、有空的
access → accessible　進得去的、可使用的

body: 表示「與……有關的」。
表示「有這種作用或傾向的」。
pairs: impress → impressive　令人印象深刻的

body: 兩個都是形容詞。-ed 形容人的感受，-ing 形容造成那種感受的事物。
I'm interested in this job. 我對這份工作有興趣。The book is interesting. 這本書很有趣。
同類的還有 bored / boring（感到無聊／令人無聊）、tired / tiring（感到累／令人累）、excited / exciting（感到興奮／令人興奮）。
items.note: 所以 I'm interested in this job. 是對的。I interesting in this job. 少了 be，字尾也不對。

groups.title: 副詞
groups.intro: 副詞常修飾動詞，告訴你動作是「怎麼做的」。

body: 多數形容詞加 -ly 變成副詞。careful → carefully　小心地。successful → successfully　成功地。
拼字有三條常見規則。第一，子音加 y：把 y 改成 i 再加 ly。happy → happily，easy → easily。
第二，字尾是 -le：去掉 e，加上 y。gentle → gently，possible → possibly。
第三，字尾是 -ic：多半加 -ally。basic → basically，automatic → automatically。例外要單獨記：public → publicly。
items.note: hard 不是加 -ly 就變成「努力地」。work hard 的 hard 本身就是副詞，意思是努力地、猛烈地。hardly 是另一個字，意思是「幾乎不」。She hardly works. 是她幾乎不工作，不是她很努力。

groups.title: 動詞
groups.intro: 這些字尾把名詞或形容詞變成動詞。

body: 表示「使成為、做成」。英式拼法常寫成 -ise，多益兩個拼法都看過，題目通常只留一個。
表示「變成、使變得」。
表示「使成為」。

groups.title: -ed 過去式
groups.intro: 規則動詞的過去式在字尾加 -ed。這和上面「感到……的」那個 -ed 形容詞是同一個形，但這裡先談過去式。

body: 一般直接加：work → worked，play → played。
字尾已經有 e，只加 d：live → lived，close → closed。
子音加 y：y 改成 i 再加 ed。study → studied。母音加 y 則不變：play → played。
單音節、一個母音再加一個子音，要重複最後一個子音：stop → stopped，plan → planned。兩個音節以上，多半只有重音在最後才重複：prefer → preferred。visit 的重音不在最後，所以是 visited。
items.note: 讀音可以先記三種感覺：清音後面比較像輕短的 t（worked、stopped）；母音或濁音後面比較像 d（played、lived）；字尾本來就是 t 或 d 時，會多一個音節（needed、wanted）。go → went、have → had 這種不規則變化要個別記。

examples.en: The campaign was a success.
We hope the plan will succeed.
examples.zh: 我們希望這個計畫會成功。

examples.en: She is a successful designer.
examples.zh: 她是一位成功的設計師。

examples.en: They successfully launched the product.
examples.zh: 他們成功地推出了這項產品。

examples.en: The poster is her latest creation.
examples.zh: 這張海報是她最新的作品。

examples.en: Her creativity impressed the client.
examples.zh: 她的創意讓客戶印象深刻。

n.note: 名詞有兩個：creation 是作品或創立，creativity 是創意。

examples.en: We need to create a simple logo.
examples.zh: 我們需要設計一個簡單的標誌。

examples.en: He is a creative writer.
examples.zh: 他是一位有創意的作者。

examples.en: She solved the problem creatively.
examples.zh: 她很有創意地解決了這個問題。

examples.en: Please handle the glass with care.
We care about product quality.
Be careful with the cables.
Read the contract carefully.
Please check the availability of the room for Friday.
examples.zh: 請確認星期五那個房間是否有空。

v.note: avail 當動詞（avail oneself of）太正式，多益很少考，這一格先空著。

examples.en: The manager is available at 4 p.m.

adv.note: available 一般不加 -ly。要說「有空的時候」，用 when available，或 if you are available。

examples.en: The demo left a good impression.
examples.zh: 這場示範留下了好印象。

examples.en: The numbers did not impress the board.
examples.zh: 這些數字沒有讓董事會印象深刻。

examples.en: It was an impressive result.
examples.zh: 這是一個很亮眼的結果。

examples.en: Sales grew impressively last quarter.
examples.zh: 上一季的銷售成長得很亮眼。

examples.en: We need a decision by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們星期五之前得做出決定。

examples.en: They will decide tomorrow.
She is a decisive leader.
He spoke decisively about the budget.
examples.zh: 他談預算的時候很果斷。

examples.en: There is a small difference in price.
Our opinions differ on this point.
examples.zh: 我們對這一點的看法不同。

examples.en: This is a different approach.
The two teams reacted differently.

families.title: please

examples.en: It is a pleasure to meet you.
The new menu will please most guests.
examples.zh: 新菜單會讓大多數客人滿意。

examples.en: We had a pleasant conversation.
She pleasantly surprised the team.

families.note: pleasant 是「令人愉快的」，形容事物或氣氛。人「感到高興」要用 pleased，例如 I am pleased. 不要和 pleasant 混在一起。

families.title: hard / hardly

examples.en: The lab measured the hardness of the metal.
examples.zh: 實驗室測量了金屬的硬度。

n.note: 這一列的重點是副詞。hardness（硬度）先認識即可。

v.note: hard 通常不作動詞。要說「使變硬」用 harden。

examples.en: The exam was hard.
She works hard.
examples.zh: 她工作很努力。（hard = 努力地）

examples.en: She hardly works on Fridays.
examples.zh: 她星期五幾乎不工作。（hardly = 幾乎不）

families.note: hardly 不是「努力地」。She works hard. 是她很努力工作。She hardly works. 是她幾乎不工作。不要寫 work hardly 來表示努力。

examples.en: The competition is strong this year.
We compete with two local firms.
examples.zh: 我們和兩家本地公司競爭。

examples.en: This is a competitive market.
examples.zh: 這是一個競爭激烈的市場。

examples.en: They priced the new model competitively.
examples.zh: 他們把新型號的價格定得很有競爭力。

quiz.full: The team completed the report successfully.
quiz.explain: completed 是動詞，要用副詞 successfully 說明「完成得怎樣」。successful 是形容詞，success 是名詞，succeed 是動詞，都不能放在這個位置。

quiz.prompt: Please confirm the _____ of the meeting room before you send the invitation.
quiz.full: Please confirm the availability of the meeting room before you send the invitation.
quiz.explain: the 後面要名詞。availability 是「是否有空、是否可訂」。available 是形容詞，不能直接接在 the 後面。

quiz.prompt: Her _____ to postpone the launch surprised everyone.
quiz.full: Her decision to postpone the launch surprised everyone.
quiz.explain: Her 後面、to postpone 前面要名詞 decision（決定）。decisive 是形容詞，decisively 是副詞，decide 是動詞。

quiz.prompt: The speaker gave an _____ presentation on customer service.
quiz.full: The speaker gave an impressive presentation on customer service.
quiz.explain: an 和 presentation（名詞）中間要形容詞 impressive。impression 是名詞，impressively 是副詞，impress 是動詞。

quiz.full: Please read the safety instructions carefully.
quiz.explain: 修飾動詞 read，用副詞 carefully（仔細地）。careful 是形容詞，care 可以是名詞或動詞，caring 在這裡也不適合。

quiz.full: The two proposals are quite different.
quiz.explain: be 後面這裡要形容詞 different。differently 是副詞，difference 是名詞，differ 是動詞。

quiz.prompt: It was a _____ to work with your department.
quiz.full: It was a pleasure to work with your department.
quiz.explain: a 後面要名詞 pleasure。pleasant 是形容詞（a pleasant day 可以，但 a pleasant to work 不行），pleasantly 是副詞，please 是動詞。

quiz.prompt: The designer is known for her _____.
quiz.full: The designer is known for her creativity.
quiz.explain: her 後面要名詞。creativity 是「創意」。creative 是形容詞，creatively 是副詞，create 是動詞。

quiz.prompt: From the back of the hall, I could _____ hear the speaker.
quiz.full: From the back of the hall, I could hardly hear the speaker.
quiz.explain: hardly 是「幾乎不」。could hardly hear 是幾乎聽不到。hard 當副詞是「努力地、猛烈地」，不能用來表示幾乎沒聽到。harden 是動詞「使變硬」，hardness 是名詞「硬度」。

quiz.prompt: The city plans to _____ the main road next year.
quiz.full: The city plans to widen the main road next year.
quiz.explain: plans to 後面要動詞原形。widen（字尾 -en）是「加寬」。wide 是形容詞，width 是名詞「寬度」，widely 是副詞。
